88long get_cpu_cores(void) {
89#if defined(_WIN32) || defined(_WIN64)
90 SYSTEM_INFO sysinfo;
91 GetSystemInfo(&sysinfo);
92 return (long)sysinfo.dwNumberOfProcessors;
93#elif defined(__linux__)
94 cpu_set_t cpuset;
95 CPU_ZERO(&cpuset);
96 if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(cpuset), &cpuset) == 0) {
97 int count = CPU_COUNT(&cpuset);
98 if (count > 0) return (long)count;
99 }
100#if defined(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN)
101 long nproc = sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN);
102 if (nproc > 0) return nproc;
103#endif
104 return 1;
105#elif defined(__FreeBSD__) || defined(__OpenBSD__) || defined(__NetBSD__) || defined(__DragonFly__)
106 int mib[2];
107 int nproc = 0;
108 size_t len = sizeof(nproc);
109 mib[0] = CTL_HW;
110#if defined(HW_NCPUONLINE)
111 mib[1] = HW_NCPUONLINE;
112#else
113 mib[1] = HW_NCPU;
114#endif
115 if (sysctl(mib, 2, &nproc, &len, NULL, 0) == 0) {
116 return (long)nproc;
117 }
118 return 4;
119#elif defined(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN)
120 long nproc = sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN);
121 if (nproc > 0) return nproc;
122 return 1;
123#else
124 return 1;
125#endif
126}

148long get_optimal_thread_count(void) {
149 if (g_http_pool_core_limit > 0) {
150 return (long)g_http_pool_core_limit;
151 }
152 const char *env = getenv("CWIST_WORKER_THREADS");
153 if (env && env[0]) {
154 char *end = NULL;
155 long override = strtol(env, &end, 10);
156 if (end != env && *end == '\0' && override > 0) return override;
157 }
158
159 long cores = get_cpu_cores();
160 if (cores < 1) cores = 1;
161
162 long workers = cores;
163 const char *w_env = getenv("CWIST_WORKERS");
164 if (w_env && w_env[0]) {
165 if (strcmp(w_env, "auto") != 0) {
166 char *end = NULL;
167 long parsed = strtol(w_env, &end, 10);
168 if (end != w_env && *end == '\0' && parsed > 0) workers = parsed;
169 }
170 }
171
172 const char *c1m = getenv("CWIST_C1M_MODE");
173 bool is_c1m = !c1m || (c1m[0] != '0' && strcmp(c1m, "false") != 0);
174
175 if (is_c1m) {
176 /* In event-driven C1M mode each reactor thread multiplexes I/O
177 * asynchronously. Target one event loop per CPU across the whole
178 * deployment: extra loops on the same CPU add no parallelism, only
179 * scheduler queueing, and the queueing lands on the tail. The CI
180 * benchmark matrix tracks this configuration on every run.
181 *
182 * `cores` is this process's own CPU budget, not the machine's:
183 * get_cpu_cores() reads sched_getaffinity(), and with workers > 1
184 * every worker has already been pinned to a single CPU by
185 * cwist_app_pin_worker() before the pool is built. So in the
186 * default pinned deployment cores is 1 here and the division
187 * below yields 0, clamped to 1 -- one loop per process. Unpinned
188 * (e.g. the CI benchmark, which deliberately sees the whole
189 * runner), cores is the machine count and the worker processes
190 * share it, so the division spreads the loops evenly across them.
191 *
192 * A higher floor would protect synchronous handoffs (h2c) and
193 * blocking handlers, but extra loops on a shared CPU cannot run
194 * concurrently there either: a blocking handler stalls its own
195 * worker's connections until it yields, while the other workers
196 * (other CPUs, shared listener) keep serving. */
197 long count = workers > 0 ? cores / workers : cores;
198 if (count < 1) count = 1;
199 if (count > 64) count = 64;
200 return count;
201 }
202
203 if (workers == 1) {
204 /* Keep-alive handlers park on their connection, so the pool must
205 * cover many more concurrent connections than there are cores.
206 * Blocked threads are nearly free (futex sleep); undersizing the
207 * pool caps throughput at threads x per-conn rate. */
208 long count = cores * 8;
209 if (count < 32) count = 32;
210 if (count > 256) count = 256;
211 return count;
212 }
213
214 /* Dynamic thread downscaling: distribute thread budget proportionally across forked worker
215 * processes */
216 long threads_per_worker = (cores * 8) / workers;
217 if (threads_per_worker < 8) threads_per_worker = 8;
218 if (threads_per_worker > 64) threads_per_worker = 64;
219 return threads_per_worker;
220}

239/* Generation of the C1M worker reactors. cwist_http_pool_destroy() bumps it
240 * before it stops and frees them, so a deferred completion that still holds
241 * a reactor from an earlier generation (cwist_async outlives the server)
242 * closes its connection instead of posting into freed memory. Posters count
243 * themselves in g_reactor_posters around the check and the post; destroy
244 * waits for that count to drain after the bump, so every post that saw the
245 * old generation lands before the reactors' final drain. Both sides use
246 * sequentially consistent atomics, so one of them always sees the other. */
247static _Atomic uint64_t g_reactor_gen = 0;
248static _Atomic long g_reactor_posters = 0;

300static long cwist_http_inflight_limit(void) {
301 long base = g_http_thread_count > 0 ? g_http_thread_count : get_optimal_thread_count();
302 long floor = base * CWIST_HTTP_INFLIGHT_PER_THREAD;
303#ifndef __wasi__
304 struct rlimit rl;
305 if (getrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE, &rl) != 0) return floor;
306 long budget = (rl.rlim_cur == RLIM_INFINITY)
307 ? (1024L * 1024L)
308 : (long)rl.rlim_cur - CWIST_HTTP_INFLIGHT_FD_RESERVE;
309 return budget > floor ? budget : floor;
310#else
311 /* WASI preview1 has no rlimit; the thread-count floor is enough. */
312 return floor;
313#endif
314}

335/* Dynamic Thread Pool for Classic Mode
336 * Combines pre-allocated idle worker threads with fast job queue and
337 * on-demand scaling to eliminate starvation on compute/keepalive workloads
338 * while avoiding per-connection pthread_create overhead. */
339#define CWIST_POOL_STACK_SIZE (256 * 1024)
340
341typedef struct http_pool_task {
342 int client_fd;
343 void (*handler_func)(int, void *);
344 void *ctx;
345 struct http_pool_task *next;
346} http_pool_task_t;
347
348typedef struct {
349 http_pool_task_t *head;
350 http_pool_task_t *tail;
351 atomic_long pending_tasks;
352 atomic_long active_workers;
353 atomic_long idle_workers;
354 atomic_long max_workers;
355 atomic_bool running;
356 pthread_mutex_t lock;
357 pthread_cond_t cond;
358} http_dynamic_pool_t;
359
360static http_dynamic_pool_t g_dyn_pool;
361
362/* RX-uring RECV completion entry for the async connection path; defined
363 * with the async helpers below. Registered as the reactor's rx_cb in
364 * cwist_http_pool_init. */
365static void http_rx_recv_cb(void *conn_ptr, int res);
366
374static void *http_dynamic_worker_thread(void *arg) {
375 (void)arg;
376 while (atomic_load_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.running, memory_order_acquire)) {
377 http_pool_task_t *task = NULL;
378
379 pthread_mutex_lock(&g_dyn_pool.lock);
380 while (atomic_load_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.running, memory_order_acquire) &&
381 !g_dyn_pool.head) {
382 /* Scale-down idle timeout: CWIST_POOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS overrides
383 * the 2s default; 0 parks surplus threads forever (use with
384 * CWIST_POOL_PREWARM to eliminate spawn churn entirely). */
385 static _Atomic long idle_timeout_ms = -1;
386 long ms = atomic_load_explicit(&idle_timeout_ms, memory_order_relaxed);
387 if (ms < 0) {
388 const char *env = getenv("CWIST_POOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS");
389 if (env && *env) {
390 char *end = NULL;
391 long v = strtol(env, &end, 10);
392 ms = (end != env && *end == '\0') ? v : 2000;
393 } else {
394 ms = 2000;
395 }
396 if (ms < 0) ms = 2000;
397 atomic_store_explicit(&idle_timeout_ms, ms, memory_order_relaxed);
398 }
399 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.idle_workers, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
400 int rc;
401 if (ms == 0) {
402 rc = pthread_cond_wait(&g_dyn_pool.cond, &g_dyn_pool.lock);
403 } else {
404 struct timespec ts;
405 clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
406 ts.tv_sec += ms / 1000;
407 ts.tv_nsec += (ms % 1000) * 1000000L;
408 if (ts.tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) {
409 ts.tv_sec++;
410 ts.tv_nsec -= 1000000000L;
411 }
412 rc = pthread_cond_timedwait(&g_dyn_pool.cond, &g_dyn_pool.lock, &ts);
413 }
414 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.idle_workers, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
415 if (rc == ETIMEDOUT && !g_dyn_pool.head) {
416 /* Scale down if idle and above base worker threshold */
417 long current =
418 atomic_load_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.active_workers, memory_order_relaxed);
419 if (current > g_http_thread_count) {
420 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.active_workers, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
421 pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_dyn_pool.lock);
422 return NULL;
423 }
424 }
425 }
426
427 if (!atomic_load_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.running, memory_order_acquire)) {
428 pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_dyn_pool.lock);
429 break;
430 }
431
432 task = g_dyn_pool.head;
433 if (task) {
434 g_dyn_pool.head = task->next;
435 if (!g_dyn_pool.head) g_dyn_pool.tail = NULL;
436 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.pending_tasks, 1, memory_order_release);
437 }
438 pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_dyn_pool.lock);
439
440 if (task) {
441 int fd = task->client_fd;
442 void (*handler)(int, void *) = task->handler_func;
443 void *ctx = task->ctx;
444 cwist_free(task);
445
446 ttak_net_lattice_set_worker_id((uint32_t)(uintptr_t)pthread_self());
447 if (handler) handler(fd, ctx);
448 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&g_http_inflight, 1, memory_order_release);
449 }
450 }
451 return NULL;
452}

462static bool http_spawn_worker(void) {
463 pthread_attr_t attr;
464 pthread_attr_init(&attr);
465 pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&attr, PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);
466 /* Cap worker stack reservation: the default 8MB dwarfs the worker's real
467 * worst case (16KB read_buf + 8KB header_buf + 64KB file-stream fallback
468 * buffer plus call-chain slack). Note glibc rejects sizes smaller than
469 * the process' static TLS footprint (allocatestack.c), which is why the
470 * HTTP/3 batch scratch buffers must stay out of TLS. */
471 if (pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, CWIST_POOL_STACK_SIZE) != 0) {
472 CWIST_LOG_WARN("[http] pthread_attr_setstacksize(%d) failed; using default stack",
473 CWIST_POOL_STACK_SIZE);
474 }
475 pthread_t tid;
476 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.active_workers, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
477 int rc = pthread_create(&tid, &attr, http_dynamic_worker_thread, NULL);
478 if (rc != 0) {
479 /* Retry with the default stack rather than losing the worker. */
480 pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
481 pthread_attr_init(&attr);
482 pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&attr, PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);
483 rc = pthread_create(&tid, &attr, http_dynamic_worker_thread, NULL);
484 }
485 pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
486 if (rc != 0) {
487 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.active_workers, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
488 return false;
489 }
490 return true;
491}

515int cwist_http_pool_init_mode(bool use_c1m) {
516 atomic_store(&g_http_pool_stopping, false);
517 g_http_thread_count = get_optimal_thread_count();
518
519 if (use_c1m) {
520 /* Pre-allocate reactor workers for async path (CWIST_C1M_MODE=1) */
521 g_workers = cwist_alloc(g_http_thread_count * sizeof(http_thread_worker_t));
522 if (!g_workers) return -1;
523 g_worker_loads = cwist_alloc(g_http_thread_count * sizeof(_Atomic uint32_t));
524 if (!g_worker_loads) {
525 cwist_free(g_workers);
526 g_workers = NULL;
527 return -1;
528 }
529 for (int i = 0; i < g_http_thread_count; i++) atomic_init(&g_worker_loads[i], 0);
530 g_rr_index = 0;
531 memset(g_workers, 0, g_http_thread_count * sizeof(http_thread_worker_t));
532
533 for (int i = 0; i < g_http_thread_count; i++) {
534 g_workers[i].reactor = cwist_reactor_create();
535 if (!g_workers[i].reactor) return -1;
536 /* RX-uring receive path: route tagged RECV completions into the
537 * HTTP connection state machine (no-op where unsupported). */
538 cwist_reactor_set_rx_cb(g_workers[i].reactor, http_rx_recv_cb);
539 g_workers[i].worker_id = (uint32_t)i;
540 if (pthread_create(&g_workers[i].thread, NULL, http_pool_worker, &g_workers[i]) != 0) {
541 return -1;
542 }
543 }
544 } else {
545 /* Initialize dynamic worker pool for classic path (CWIST_C1M_MODE=0) */
546 g_dyn_pool.head = NULL;
547 g_dyn_pool.tail = NULL;
548 atomic_init(&g_dyn_pool.pending_tasks, 0);
549 atomic_init(&g_dyn_pool.active_workers, 0);
550 atomic_init(&g_dyn_pool.idle_workers, 0);
551 atomic_init(&g_dyn_pool.max_workers, 65536);
552 atomic_init(&g_dyn_pool.running, true);
553
554 pthread_mutex_init(&g_dyn_pool.lock, NULL);
555 pthread_cond_init(&g_dyn_pool.cond, NULL);
556
557 /* Pre-warm worker threads. CWIST_POOL_PREWARM extends the spawn count
558 * beyond the base pool when the expected concurrency is known, so the
559 * acceptor does not serialize pthread_create + stack mmap during a
560 * connection ramp. */
561 long prewarm = g_http_thread_count;
562 const char *pw = getenv("CWIST_POOL_PREWARM");
563 if (pw && *pw) {
564 char *end = NULL;
565 long parsed = strtol(pw, &end, 10);
566 if (end == pw || *end != '\0') parsed = 0;
567 if (parsed > prewarm) prewarm = parsed;
568 }
569 long max_w = atomic_load_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.max_workers, memory_order_relaxed);
570 if (prewarm > max_w) prewarm = max_w;
571 for (long i = 0; i < prewarm; i++) {
572 if (!http_spawn_worker()) {
573 return -1;
574 }
575 }
576 }
577 return 0;
578}

586void cwist_http_pool_submit(int client_fd, void (*handler)(int, void *), void *ctx) {
587 long limit = cwist_http_inflight_limit();
588 long inflight = atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_http_inflight, 1, memory_order_acq_rel) + 1;
589 if (inflight > limit) {
590 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&g_http_inflight, 1, memory_order_release);
591#ifdef MSG_NOSIGNAL
592 send(client_fd, CWIST_HTTP_503, sizeof(CWIST_HTTP_503) - 1, MSG_NOSIGNAL | MSG_DONTWAIT);
593#endif
594 close(client_fd);
595 return;
596 }
597
598 http_pool_task_t *node = cwist_alloc(sizeof(*node));
599 if (!node) {
600 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&g_http_inflight, 1, memory_order_release);
601 close(client_fd);
602 return;
603 }
604 node->client_fd = client_fd;
605 node->handler_func = handler;
606 node->ctx = ctx;
607 node->next = NULL;
608
609 pthread_mutex_lock(&g_dyn_pool.lock);
610 if (!g_dyn_pool.tail) {
611 g_dyn_pool.head = node;
612 g_dyn_pool.tail = node;
613 } else {
614 g_dyn_pool.tail->next = node;
615 g_dyn_pool.tail = node;
616 }
617 long pending =
618 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.pending_tasks, 1, memory_order_release) + 1;
619
620 /* Signalled sleepers remain counted idle until they reacquire this lock.
621 * Compare queued demand with that capacity, not merely idle == 0: a
622 * burst can otherwise strand connections behind busy keep-alive handlers.
623 * Keep the cap check and the spawn reservation in this critical section. */
624 long current = atomic_load_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.active_workers, memory_order_relaxed);
625 long idle = atomic_load_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.idle_workers, memory_order_relaxed);
626 long max_w = atomic_load_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.max_workers, memory_order_relaxed);
627 if (pending > idle && current < max_w) {
628 http_spawn_worker();
629 }
630 pthread_cond_signal(&g_dyn_pool.cond);
631 pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_dyn_pool.lock);
632}

638bool cwist_http_pool_rearm_current(int client_fd, void (*handler)(int, void *), void *ctx) {
639 if (client_fd < 0 || !handler) return false;
640 cwist_http_pool_submit(client_fd, handler, ctx);
641 return true;
642}

650void cwist_http_pool_destroy(void) {
651 /* Queued continuations must release, not repost into a dying reactor. */
652 atomic_store(&g_http_pool_stopping, true);
653 atomic_store_explicit(&g_dyn_pool.running, false, memory_order_release);
654 pthread_mutex_lock(&g_dyn_pool.lock);
655 pthread_cond_broadcast(&g_dyn_pool.cond);
656 pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_dyn_pool.lock);
657
658 /* Drain tasks */
659 pthread_mutex_lock(&g_dyn_pool.lock);
660 http_pool_task_t *node = g_dyn_pool.head;
661 g_dyn_pool.head = NULL;
662 g_dyn_pool.tail = NULL;
663 while (node) {
664 http_pool_task_t *next = node->next;
665 if (node->client_fd >= 0) close(node->client_fd);
666 cwist_free(node);
667 node = next;
668 }
669 pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_dyn_pool.lock);
670
671 pthread_cond_destroy(&g_dyn_pool.cond);
672 pthread_mutex_destroy(&g_dyn_pool.lock);
673
674 /* Retire this generation of reactors before they go; see g_reactor_gen. */
675 atomic_fetch_add(&g_reactor_gen, 1);
676 while (atomic_load(&g_reactor_posters) > 0) sched_yield();
677
678 if (g_workers) {
679 for (int i = 0; i < g_http_thread_count; i++) {
680 if (g_workers[i].reactor) {
681 cwist_reactor_stop(g_workers[i].reactor);
682 }
683 }
684 for (int i = 0; i < g_http_thread_count; i++) {
685 pthread_join(g_workers[i].thread, NULL);
686 if (g_workers[i].reactor) {
687 cwist_reactor_destroy(g_workers[i].reactor);
688 g_workers[i].reactor = NULL;
689 }
690 }
691 cwist_free(g_workers);
692 g_workers = NULL;
693 if (g_worker_loads) {
694 cwist_free(g_worker_loads);
695 g_worker_loads = NULL;
696 }
697 }
698}
699/* --- End Thread Pool --- */
700
701/* --- Async (one-shot, event-driven) connection path ------------------------
702 * See include/cwist/net/http/http.h for the model overview. The connection
703 * shell lives across events; the recv stash is allocated lazily and released
704 * whenever it drains to empty, so an idle keep-alive connection costs only
705 * the shell plus its reactor slot. */
706
707typedef struct {
708 int client_fd;
709 cwist_async_handler_t handler;
710 void *ctx;
711 cwist_reactor_t *reactor;
712 cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn;
713} http_async_ctx_t;
714
715/* Defined below; referenced earlier by the RX-uring helpers. */
716static void http_async_event_cb(int fd, void *ctx);
717static bool http_async_stash_grow(cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn, size_t need);
718
724static uint32_t cwist_http_keep_alive_timeout_sec(void) {
725 static int cached_timeout = -1;
726 if (cached_timeout < 0) {
727 const char *env = getenv("CWIST_HTTP_KEEP_ALIVE_TIMEOUT");
728 int val = 0;
729 if (env && *env) {
730 char *end = NULL;
731 long v = strtol(env, &end, 10);
732 if (end != env && *end == '\0' && v > 0 && v <= INT_MAX) val = (int)v;
733 }
734 cached_timeout = (val > 0) ? val : CWIST_HTTP_KEEP_ALIVE_TIMEOUT_SEC;
735 }
736 return (uint32_t)cached_timeout;
737}
738
745static void http_async_conn_release(cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn) {
746 if (!conn) return;
747 if (g_worker_loads && conn->worker_id < (uint32_t)g_http_thread_count) {
748 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&g_worker_loads[conn->worker_id], 1, memory_order_relaxed);
749 }
750 cwist_free(conn->rbuf);
751 cwist_free(conn->obuf);
752 cwist_free(conn);
753 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&g_http_inflight, 1, memory_order_release);
754}
755
756/* Minimum free stash bytes required before arming a RECV SQE. Below this
757 * floor the legacy POLL + recv-drain path runs the stash growth instead. */
758#define CWIST_RX_REARM_MIN_AVAIL 1024
759
760/* Idle-keep-alive shrink floor for the rbuf/obuf stashes at rearm: an idle
761 * connection holds ~KB, not 32 KB, while the grow-on-demand paths restore
762 * capacity on the next busy turn. Must satisfy CWIST_RX_REARM_MIN_AVAIL so
763 * the RECV-first arm stays available. */
764#define CWIST_ASYNC_STASH_IDLE 4096
765
777static bool http_async_arm_wait(int fd, cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn,
778 cwist_async_handler_t handler, void *ctx,
779 cwist_reactor_t *reactor) {
780 http_async_ctx_t next = {
781 .client_fd = fd,
782 .handler = handler,
783 .ctx = ctx,
784 .reactor = reactor,
785 .conn = conn,
786 };
787 if (cwist_reactor_rx_supported(reactor) && !conn->peer_eof && !conn->rx_recv_inflight &&
788 !conn->rx_prefers_poll) {
789 if (conn->cap == 0 && !http_async_stash_grow(conn, CWIST_HTTP_READ_BUFFER_SIZE)) {
790 /* Stash allocation failed: the legacy fill path retries growth
791 * when POLL fires and closes on failure, matching today. */
792 } else if (conn->cap > 0) {
793 size_t avail = conn->cap - 1 - conn->len;
794 if (avail >= CWIST_RX_REARM_MIN_AVAIL) {
795 /* Mark the RECV in flight BEFORE submitting the SQE. The
796 * acceptor thread is not this reactor's owner, so the kernel
797 * can complete the SQE and the owner thread can dispatch the
798 * connection to close (and free it) while this function is
799 * still running; any conn write after submission is a
800 * use-after-free. Roll back on submission failure so the
801 * POLL fallback below sees the un-armed state. */
802 conn->rx_recv_inflight = true;
803 if (cwist_reactor_recv_arm(reactor, fd, conn->rbuf + conn->len, (unsigned)avail,
804 conn, &conn->rx_armed_ns)) {
805 return true;
806 }
807 conn->rx_recv_inflight = false;
808 }
809 }
810 /* Low headroom or arm failure: fall through to the POLL wait. */
811 }
812 return cwist_reactor_add(reactor, fd, http_async_event_cb, &next, sizeof(next));
813}
814
818static void http_async_dispatch(int fd, cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn,
819 cwist_async_handler_t handler, void *ctx,
820 cwist_reactor_t *reactor) {
821 cwist_async_action_t action = handler(fd, conn);
822
823 if (action == CWIST_ASYNC_DEFER) {
824 /* The handler parked the request on a cwist_async; the completion
825 * path owns fd and conn now and re-arms or closes when done. */
826 return;
827 }
828 if (action == CWIST_ASYNC_DETACH) {
829 /* The handler owns fd now (h2c preface, protocol upgrade). Free the
830 * shell but never touch the fd. */
831 if (g_worker_loads && conn->worker_id < (uint32_t)g_http_thread_count) {
832 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&g_worker_loads[conn->worker_id], 1, memory_order_relaxed);
833 }
834 cwist_free(conn->rbuf);
835 cwist_free(conn->obuf);
836 cwist_free(conn);
837 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&g_http_inflight, 1, memory_order_release);
838 return;
839 }
840 if (action == CWIST_ASYNC_CLOSE) {
841 close(fd);
842 http_async_conn_release(conn);
843 return;
844 }
845
846 /* CWIST_ASYNC_REARM: keep the stashes allocated across keep-alive
847 * requests to avoid per-request heap churn, but shrink an idle
848 * connection's buffers toward a small floor. A served keep-alive
849 * connection otherwise holds 16 KiB rbuf + 16 KiB obuf for its whole
850 * idle lifetime (~24 KB RSS per connection at C1M scale); the
851 * grow-on-demand paths (http_async_stash_grow, coalesce serialize)
852 * restore capacity on the next busy turn. */
853 if (conn->len == 0 && conn->cap > CWIST_ASYNC_STASH_IDLE) {
854 char *nb = cwist_realloc(conn->rbuf, CWIST_ASYNC_STASH_IDLE);
855 if (nb) {
856 conn->rbuf = nb;
857 conn->cap = CWIST_ASYNC_STASH_IDLE;
858 }
859 }
860 if (conn->olen == 0 && conn->ocap > CWIST_ASYNC_STASH_IDLE) {
861 char *nb = cwist_realloc(conn->obuf, CWIST_ASYNC_STASH_IDLE);
862 if (nb) {
863 conn->obuf = nb;
864 conn->ocap = CWIST_ASYNC_STASH_IDLE;
865 }
866 }
867
868 if (!http_async_arm_wait(fd, conn, handler, ctx, reactor)) {
869 if (getenv("CWIST_ASYNC_DEBUG")) {
870 static _Atomic long dbg_rearm_fail;
871 long n = atomic_fetch_add(&dbg_rearm_fail, 1) + 1;
872 if (n <= 5 || n % 10000 == 0)
873 fprintf(stderr, "[async] rearm failed fd=%d total=%ld\n", fd, n);
874 }
875 close(fd);
876 http_async_conn_release(conn);
877 }
878}
879
885static void http_rx_recv_cb(void *conn_ptr, int res) {
886 cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn = (cwist_http_async_conn_t *)conn_ptr;
887 conn->rx_recv_inflight = false;
888
889 if (res == -ECANCELED) {
890 /* The deferred submission failed (SQ wedged) or the ring tore down;
891 * legacy arm-failure semantics: close fd and release the shell. */
892 close(conn->fd);
893 http_async_conn_release(conn);
894 return;
895 }
896 if (res == 0) {
897 /* EOF: do not re-arm; the handler drains complete buffered requests
898 * and then closes through the existing peer_eof path. */
899 conn->peer_eof = true;
900 } else if (res < 0 && res != -EAGAIN) {
901 close(conn->fd);
902 http_async_conn_release(conn);
903 return;
904 } else if (res > 0) {
905 conn->len += (size_t)res;
906 conn->rbuf[conn->len] = '\0';
907 conn->virgin = false;
908 }
909 /* res == -EAGAIN: nothing staged; the POLL fallback below resumes the
910 * wait without running the handler on an empty stash. */
911
912 /* Latency probe: rx_armed_ns is only written while the probe is enabled,
913 * so a zero value means the probe is off and both clock reads below are
914 * skipped. Snapshot it now: the serve path re-arms the next RECV and
915 * would overwrite conn->rx_armed_ns before the queue delay is computed. */
916 uint64_t t0 = 0;
917 uint64_t armed_ns = conn->rx_armed_ns;
918 if (armed_ns) {
919 struct timespec ts;
920 clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
921 t0 = (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec;
922 }
923 conn->last_active_sec = cwist_fast_monotonic_sec();
924
925 if (res == -EAGAIN) {
926 /* Data not ready: hand the wait to the legacy one-shot POLL. Arm
927 * POLL directly (NOT http_async_arm_wait, which is RECV-first and
928 * would immediately re-arm a RECV, livelocking on -EAGAIN). When
929 * POLL fires, http_async_event_cb re-arms a RECV and the completion
930 * drives from there.
931 *
932 * Learn: this client sends one request per idle period (wrk-style
933 * keepalive), so an armed RECV just burns an SQE before the POLL
934 * fallback every round. Prefer POLL until a RECV actually stages
935 * bytes again (pipelining detected), keeping the steady-state op
936 * count identical to the legacy path. */
937 conn->rx_prefers_poll = true;
938 http_async_ctx_t next = {
939 .client_fd = conn->fd,
940 .handler = conn->handler,
941 .ctx = conn->user_ctx,
942 .reactor = conn->reactor,
943 .conn = conn,
944 };
945 if (!cwist_reactor_add(conn->reactor, conn->fd, http_async_event_cb, &next, sizeof(next))) {
946 close(conn->fd);
947 http_async_conn_release(conn);
948 }
949 return;
950 }
951
952 /* rx_data_ready tells cwist_http_async_conn_fill the bytes are already
953 * in the stash (or EOF is already recorded); never recv() on top of a
954 * RECV completion. Bytes flowed: a pipelining client gets the SQE
955 * path again. */
956 conn->rx_data_ready = true;
957 conn->rx_prefers_poll = false;
958 http_async_dispatch(conn->fd, conn, conn->handler, conn->user_ctx, conn->reactor);
959
960 if (armed_ns) {
961 uint64_t queue_us = (t0 - armed_ns) / 1000;
962 struct timespec ts;
963 clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
964 uint64_t t1 = (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec;
965 cwist_reactor_probe_record(conn->reactor, true, queue_us);
966 cwist_reactor_probe_record(conn->reactor, false, (t1 - t0) / 1000);
967 }
968}
969
970/* Engine-internal teardown for the async pool: drain pending receive-queue
971 * bytes so the kernel answers with FIN instead of RST, then close and release.
972 * Must run on the connection's reactor owner thread (the reactor may still
973 * have the fd armed); not part of the public API. Defined below. */
974static void http_async_close(int client_fd, cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn);
975
983static void http_async_event_cb(int fd, void *ctx) {
984 http_async_ctx_t *c = (http_async_ctx_t *)ctx;
985 cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn = c->conn;
986 cwist_async_handler_t handler = c->handler;
987
988 uint32_t now = cwist_fast_monotonic_sec();
989 uint32_t timeout_sec = cwist_http_keep_alive_timeout_sec();
990
991 /* Idle connection reaper: close keep-alive sockets that exceeded timeout.
992 * A client may have pipelined a request into the post-timeout,
993 * pre-dispatch window; drain before closing so the teardown is a
994 * graceful FIN, not an RST that flushes the peer's queued bytes. The
995 * triggering one-shot slot is consumed, so closing here is safe. */
996 if (conn->last_active_sec > 0 && (now - conn->last_active_sec) > timeout_sec) {
997 http_async_close(fd, conn);
998 return;
999 }
1000 conn->last_active_sec = now;
1001
1002 if (cwist_reactor_rx_supported(c->reactor) && !conn->rx_recv_inflight && !conn->peer_eof &&
1003 conn->len == 0 && !conn->rx_prefers_poll) {
1004 /* POLL is only a readiness trigger on the RX path: with an empty
1005 * stash the wait moves to a RECV SQE whose completion drives the
1006 * state machine. (POLL gets armed only by the -EAGAIN and
1007 * low-headroom fallbacks.) Buffered bytes (continuation posts,
1008 * parked-writer resumes) must be served, not waited on, so they
1009 * fall through to the legacy dispatch below. If the arm fails,
1010 * fall through to the legacy inline drain. */
1011 if (http_async_arm_wait(fd, conn, handler, c->ctx, c->reactor)) return;
1012 }
1013
1014 http_async_dispatch(fd, conn, handler, c->ctx, c->reactor);
1015}
1016
1017typedef struct {
1018 cwist_reactor_post_t post;
1019 http_async_ctx_t next;
1020} http_async_continuation_t;
1021
1028static void http_async_continue(void *ctx) {
1029 http_async_continuation_t *continuation = ctx;
1030 http_async_ctx_t next = continuation->next;
1031 cwist_free(continuation);
1032 if (!atomic_load(&g_cwist_running) || atomic_load(&g_http_pool_stopping)) {
1033 http_async_close(next.client_fd, next.conn);
1034 return;
1035 }
1036 http_async_event_cb(next.client_fd, &next);
1037}
1038
1047bool cwist_http_async_rearm(int client_fd, cwist_reactor_t *reactor,
1048 cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn) {
1049 if (client_fd < 0 || !reactor || !conn) return false;
1050 /* A deferred response may finish in reactor_destroy's final drain. Never
1051 * enqueue new work into that final snapshot or the connection is orphaned. */
1052 if (atomic_load(&g_http_pool_stopping)) {
1053 http_async_close(client_fd, conn);
1054 return false;
1055 }
1056 if (conn->peer_eof && conn->len == 0) {
1057 http_async_close(client_fd, conn);
1058 return false;
1059 }
1060 conn->last_active_sec = cwist_fast_monotonic_sec();
1061 http_async_ctx_t next = {
1062 .client_fd = client_fd,
1063 .handler = conn->handler,
1064 .ctx = conn->user_ctx,
1065 .reactor = reactor,
1066 .conn = conn,
1067 };
1068 if (conn->len > 0) {
1069 /* Pipelined bytes already sit in the stash: waiting for POLLIN would
1070 * hang. Post instead of recursing inline, so ready connections can
1071 * run between bounded HTTP request batches. */
1072 http_async_continuation_t *continuation = cwist_alloc(sizeof(*continuation));
1073 if (!continuation) {
1074 http_async_close(client_fd, conn);
1075 return false;
1076 }
1077 continuation->next = next;
1078 continuation->post = (cwist_reactor_post_t){
1079 .cb = http_async_continue,
1080 .ctx = continuation,
1081 };
1082 if (!cwist_reactor_post(reactor, &continuation->post)) {
1083 long n =
1084 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_http_continuation_shed, 1, memory_order_relaxed) + 1;
1085 cwist_metric_inc(cwist_metrics_registry(), CWIST_METRIC_HTTP_CONTINUATION_SHED);
1086 if (getenv("CWIST_ASYNC_DEBUG") && (n <= 5 || n % 10000 == 0))
1087 fprintf(stderr, "[async] continuation shed fd=%d total=%ld\n", client_fd, n);
1088 cwist_free(continuation);
1089 http_async_close(client_fd, conn);
1090 return false;
1091 }
1092 return true;
1093 }
1094 /* Same stash shrink as the REARM path in http_async_event_cb. */
1095 if (conn->len == 0 && conn->cap > 65536) {
1096 cwist_free(conn->rbuf);
1097 conn->rbuf = NULL;
1098 conn->cap = 0;
1099 }
1100 /* RX-uring: RECV-first re-arm when the ring supports it (peer_eof was
1101 * handled above, so the wait is a plain receive wait). arm_wait falls
1102 * back to the legacy one-shot POLL on unsupported reactors or arm
1103 * failure. */
1104 if (!http_async_arm_wait(client_fd, conn, conn->handler, conn->user_ctx, reactor)) {
1105 close(client_fd);
1106 http_async_conn_release(conn);
1107 return false;
1108 }
1109 return true;
1110}
1111
1117static void http_async_close(int client_fd, cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn) {
1118 if (client_fd >= 0) {
1119 /* close() on a socket with unread receive-queue data makes the
1120 * kernel answer with RST instead of a graceful FIN. A client can
1121 * pipeline its next request onto a connection the server is
1122 * closing, leaving those bytes unconsumed here; under connection
1123 * churn that turned most teardowns into abortive closes (the RST
1124 * also flushes response bytes the peer had not read yet). Drain
1125 * whatever is pending before closing; the socket is about to be
1126 * destroyed anyway. Mirrors https_connection_teardown(). */
1127 char drain[2048];
1128 ssize_t n;
1129 int guard = 16;
1130 while (guard-- > 0 && (n = recv(client_fd, drain, sizeof(drain), MSG_DONTWAIT)) > 0) {
1131 /* discard */
1132 }
1133 (void)n;
1134 close(client_fd);
1135 }
1136 http_async_conn_release(conn);
1137}
1138
1145void cwist_http_async_close_orphan(int client_fd, cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn) {
1146 /* The worker that owned conn is gone, and its load slot index may belong
1147 * to a later pool by now: leave the load counters alone. */
1148 if (conn) conn->worker_id = UINT32_MAX;
1149 http_async_close(client_fd, conn);
1150}
1151
1160bool cwist_http_pool_submit_async(int client_fd, cwist_async_handler_t handler, void *ctx) {
1161 long limit = cwist_http_inflight_limit();
1162 long inflight = atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_http_inflight, 1, memory_order_acq_rel) + 1;
1163 if (inflight > limit) {
1164 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&g_http_inflight, 1, memory_order_release);
1165#ifdef MSG_NOSIGNAL
1166 send(client_fd, CWIST_HTTP_503, sizeof(CWIST_HTTP_503) - 1, MSG_NOSIGNAL | MSG_DONTWAIT);
1167#endif
1168 close(client_fd);
1169 return false;
1170 }
1171
1172 /* The one-shot path must never park the reactor on a blocking recv. */
1173 int fl = fcntl(client_fd, F_GETFL, 0);
1174 if (fl >= 0) fcntl(client_fd, F_SETFL, fl | O_NONBLOCK);
1175
1176 cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn = cwist_alloc(sizeof(*conn));
1177 if (!conn) {
1178 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&g_http_inflight, 1, memory_order_release);
1179 close(client_fd);
1180 return false;
1181 }
1182 memset(conn, 0, sizeof(*conn));
1183 conn->fd = client_fd;
1184 conn->user_ctx = ctx;
1185 conn->virgin = true;
1186 conn->last_active_sec = cwist_fast_monotonic_sec();
1187
1188 /* Worker selection: Power of Two Random Choices (P2C) load balancing
1189 * to eliminate queue skew without cache-bouncing work stealing. */
1190 size_t worker_idx;
1191 if (g_worker_loads && g_http_thread_count > 1) {
1192 worker_idx = cwist_sched_p2c_select_worker(g_worker_loads, (uint32_t)g_http_thread_count);
1193 } else {
1194 worker_idx = g_rr_index;
1195 g_rr_index = (g_rr_index + 1) % (size_t)g_http_thread_count;
1196 }
1197 http_thread_worker_t *w = &g_workers[worker_idx];
1198
1199 conn->worker_id = (uint32_t)worker_idx;
1200 if (g_worker_loads) {
1201 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_worker_loads[worker_idx], 1, memory_order_relaxed);
1202 }
1203 conn->reactor = w->reactor;
1204 conn->handler = handler;
1205
1206 /* RX-uring: when the worker reactor has a real io_uring ring, the first
1207 * receive wait is a RECV SQE into the (freshly grown) stash whose
1208 * completion drives the state machine; on any arm failure the legacy
1209 * one-shot POLL is armed instead. */
1210 if (http_async_arm_wait(client_fd, conn, handler, ctx, w->reactor)) return true;
1211
1212 if (getenv("CWIST_ASYNC_DEBUG")) {
1213 static _Atomic long dbg_submit_fail;
1214 long n = atomic_fetch_add(&dbg_submit_fail, 1) + 1;
1215 if (n <= 5 || n % 10000 == 0)
1216 fprintf(stderr, "[async] submit-add failed fd=%d total=%ld worker=%zu\n", client_fd, n,
1217 worker_idx);
1218 }
1219 http_async_conn_release(conn);
1220 close(client_fd);
1221 return false;
1222}
1223
1224/* --- End Async Connection Path --- */
1225
1231const int CWIST_CREATE_SOCKET_FAILED = -1;
1232const int CWIST_HTTP_UNAVAILABLE_ADDRESS = -2;
1233const int CWIST_HTTP_BIND_FAILED = -3;
1234const int CWIST_HTTP_SETSOCKOPT_FAILED = -4;
1235const int CWIST_HTTP_LISTEN_FAILED = -5;
1236
1237/* --- Helpers --- */
1238
1244const char *cwist_http_method_to_string(cwist_http_method_t method) {
1245 switch (method) {
1246 case CWIST_HTTP_GET: return "GET";
1247 case CWIST_HTTP_POST: return "POST";
1248 case CWIST_HTTP_PUT: return "PUT";
1249 case CWIST_HTTP_DELETE: return "DELETE";
1250 case CWIST_HTTP_PATCH: return "PATCH";
1251 case CWIST_HTTP_HEAD: return "HEAD";
1252 case CWIST_HTTP_OPTIONS: return "OPTIONS";
1253 case CWIST_HTTP_CONNECT: return "CONNECT";
1254 default: return "UNKNOWN";
1255 }
1256}
1257
1258#define MAKE_MAGIC4(a, b, c, d) \
1259 ((uint32_t)(a) | ((uint32_t)(b) << 8) | ((uint32_t)(c) << 16) | ((uint32_t)(d) << 24))
1260
1261#define MAGIC_GET MAKE_MAGIC4('G', 'E', 'T', ' ')
1262#define MAGIC_POST MAKE_MAGIC4('P', 'O', 'S', 'T')
1263#define MAGIC_PUT MAKE_MAGIC4('P', 'U', 'T', ' ')
1264#define MAGIC_DELE MAKE_MAGIC4('D', 'E', 'L', 'E')
1265#define MAGIC_HEAD MAKE_MAGIC4('H', 'E', 'A', 'D')
1266
1274cwist_http_method_t cwist_http_string_to_method_len(const char *str, size_t len) {
1275 if (!str || len == 0) return CWIST_HTTP_UNKNOWN;
1276
1277 /* Ultra-fast path: SWAR 4-byte magic lookup for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, HEAD */
1278 if (len >= 3) {
1279 uint32_t m = 0;
1280 memcpy(&m, str, sizeof(uint32_t));
1281 switch (m) {
1282 case MAGIC_GET: return CWIST_HTTP_GET;
1283 case MAGIC_POST: return CWIST_HTTP_POST;
1284 case MAGIC_PUT: return CWIST_HTTP_PUT;
1285 case MAGIC_DELE:
1286 if (len >= 6 && memcmp(str, "DELETE", 6) == 0) return CWIST_HTTP_DELETE;
1287 break;
1288 case MAGIC_HEAD:
1289 if (len == 4) return CWIST_HTTP_HEAD;
1290 break;
1291 default: break;
1292 }
1293 }
1294
1295 if (len == 3) {
1296 uint32_t v = 0;
1297 memcpy(&v, str, 3);
1298 if ((v & 0x00FFFFFF) == 0x00544547) return CWIST_HTTP_GET;
1299 if ((v & 0x00FFFFFF) == 0x00545550) return CWIST_HTTP_PUT;
1300 } else if (len == 4) {
1301 uint32_t v = 0;
1302 memcpy(&v, str, 4);
1303 if (v == 0x54534F50) return CWIST_HTTP_POST;
1304 if (v == 0x44414548) return CWIST_HTTP_HEAD;
1305 } else if (len == 5) {
1306 if (memcmp(str, "PATCH", 5) == 0) return CWIST_HTTP_PATCH;
1307 } else if (len == 6) {
1308 if (memcmp(str, "DELETE", 6) == 0) return CWIST_HTTP_DELETE;
1309 } else if (len == 7) {
1310 if (memcmp(str, "OPTIONS", 7) == 0) return CWIST_HTTP_OPTIONS;
1311 }
1312 return CWIST_HTTP_UNKNOWN;
1313}
1314
1319cwist_http_method_t cwist_http_string_to_method(const char *method_str) {
1320 if (!method_str) return CWIST_HTTP_UNKNOWN;
1321 return cwist_http_string_to_method_len(method_str, strlen(method_str));
1322}

1332static void *cwist_http_struct_alloc(cwist_arena_t *arena, size_t size) {
1333 void *p = arena ? cwist_arena_alloc(arena, size) : NULL;
1334 if (p) {
1335 memset(p, 0, size);
1336 return p;
1337 }
1338 return cwist_alloc(size);
1339}

1349static cwist_sstring *cwist_http_sstring_create(cwist_arena_t *arena) {
1350 bool from_arena = false;
1351 cwist_sstring *str = NULL;
1352 if (arena) {
1353 str = (cwist_sstring *)cwist_arena_alloc(arena, sizeof(cwist_sstring));
1354 if (str) from_arena = true;
1355 }
1356 if (!str) {
1357 str = (cwist_sstring *)cwist_alloc(sizeof(cwist_sstring));
1358 }
1359 if (!str) return NULL;
1360
1361 memset(str, 0, sizeof(cwist_sstring));
1362 str->is_fixed = false;
1363 str->owns_storage = !from_arena;
1364 str->size = 0;
1365 str->data = NULL;
1366 str->get_size = cwist_sstring_get_size;
1367 str->compare = cwist_sstring_compare_sstring;
1368 str->copy = cwist_sstring_copy_sstring;
1369 str->append = cwist_sstring_append_sstring;
1370
1371 return str;
1372}

1382static cwist_error_t cwist_http_sstring_assign_arena(cwist_sstring *str, cwist_arena_t *arena,
1383 const char *data, size_t len) {
1384 if (arena) {
1385 char *buf = (char *)cwist_arena_alloc(arena, len + 1);
1386 if (buf) {
1387 if (str->data && !str->borrows_buffer) {
1388 cwist_free(str->base ? str->base : str->data);
1389 }
1390 if (data && len > 0) memcpy(buf, data, len);
1391 buf[len] = '\0';
1392 str->base = NULL;
1393 str->data = buf;
1394 str->size = len;
1395 str->capacity = 0;
1396 str->borrows_buffer = true;
1397 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT8);
1398 err.error.err_i8 = ERR_SSTRING_OKAY;
1399 return err;
1400 }
1401 }
1402 return cwist_sstring_assign_len(str, data, len);
1403}
1404
1408static cwist_error_t cwist_http_header_add_ex_len(cwist_http_header_node **head,
1409 cwist_arena_t *arena, const char *key,
1410 size_t key_len, const char *value,
1411 size_t value_len) {
1412 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
1413
1414 bool from_arena = false;
1415 cwist_http_header_node *node = NULL;
1416 if (arena) {
1417 node = (cwist_http_header_node *)cwist_arena_alloc(arena, sizeof(cwist_http_header_node));
1418 if (node) {
1419 memset(node, 0, sizeof(cwist_http_header_node));
1420 from_arena = true;
1421 }
1422 }
1423 if (!node) {
1424 node = (cwist_http_header_node *)cwist_alloc(sizeof(cwist_http_header_node));
1425 }
1426 if (!node) {
1427 err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_JSON);
1428 err.error.err_json = cJSON_CreateObject();
1429 cJSON_AddStringToObject(err.error.err_json, "http_error", "Failed to allocate header");
1430 return err;
1431 }
1432 node->arena_owned = from_arena;
1433
1434 node->key = cwist_http_sstring_create(arena);
1435 node->value = cwist_http_sstring_create(arena);
1436 node->next = NULL;
1437
1438 bool ok = node->key && node->value;
1439 if (ok) {
1440 cwist_error_t kerr = cwist_http_sstring_assign_arena(node->key, arena, key, key_len);
1441 ok = cwist_error_is_ok(&kerr);
1442 cwist_error_dispose(&kerr);
1443 }
1444 if (ok) {
1445 cwist_error_t verr = cwist_http_sstring_assign_arena(node->value, arena, value, value_len);
1446 ok = cwist_error_is_ok(&verr);
1447 cwist_error_dispose(&verr);
1448 }
1449 if (!ok) {
1450 /* A half-built node would serialize as an empty or missing header;
1451 * release it and report the failure instead. */
1452 cwist_http_header_free_all(node);
1453 err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_JSON);
1454 err.error.err_json = cJSON_CreateObject();
1455 cJSON_AddStringToObject(err.error.err_json, "http_error",
1456 "Failed to allocate header strings");
1457 return err;
1458 }
1459
1460 node->next = *head;
1461 *head = node;
1462
1463 err.error.err_i16 = 0; // Success
1464 return err;
1465}
1466
1475static cwist_error_t cwist_http_header_add_ex(cwist_http_header_node **head, cwist_arena_t *arena,
1476 const char *key, const char *value) {
1477 return cwist_http_header_add_ex_len(head, arena, key, key ? strlen(key) : 0, value,
1478 value ? strlen(value) : 0);
1479}
1480
1489static cwist_error_t cwist_http_header_add_static(cwist_http_header_node **head,
1490 cwist_arena_t *arena, const char *key,
1491 const char *value) {
1492 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
1493
1494 bool from_arena = false;
1495 cwist_http_header_node *node = NULL;
1496 if (arena) {
1497 node = (cwist_http_header_node *)cwist_arena_alloc(arena, sizeof(cwist_http_header_node));
1498 if (node) {
1499 memset(node, 0, sizeof(cwist_http_header_node));
1500 from_arena = true;
1501 }
1502 }
1503 if (!node) {
1504 node = (cwist_http_header_node *)cwist_alloc(sizeof(cwist_http_header_node));
1505 }
1506 if (!node) {
1507 err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_JSON);
1508 err.error.err_json = cJSON_CreateObject();
1509 cJSON_AddStringToObject(err.error.err_json, "http_error", "Failed to allocate header");
1510 return err;
1511 }
1512 node->arena_owned = from_arena;
1513
1514 node->key = cwist_http_sstring_create(arena);
1515 node->value = cwist_http_sstring_create(arena);
1516 node->next = NULL;
1517
1518 if (!node->key || !node->value) {
1519 if (!from_arena) cwist_free(node);
1520 err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_JSON);
1521 err.error.err_json = cJSON_CreateObject();
1522 cJSON_AddStringToObject(err.error.err_json, "http_error",
1523 "Failed to allocate header strings");
1524 return err;
1525 }
1526
1527 cwist_sstring_borrow(node->key, key, strlen(key));
1528 cwist_sstring_borrow(node->value, value, strlen(value));
1529
1530 node->next = *head;
1531 *head = node;
1532
1533 err.error.err_i16 = 0; // Success
1534 return err;
1535}

1538static bool cwist_http_header_text_is_safe(const char *text) {
1539 return !text || !strpbrk(text, "\r\n");
1540}
1541
1551cwist_error_t cwist_http_header_add(cwist_http_header_node **head, const char *key,
1552 const char *value) {
1553 /* The serializer writes key and value verbatim around ": " and CRLF, so a
1554 * CR or LF here would let caller-supplied data end the header early and
1555 * inject further headers or a body into the response. */
1556 if (!head || !cwist_http_header_text_is_safe(key) || !cwist_http_header_text_is_safe(value)) {
1557 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
1558 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
1559 return err;
1560 }
1561 return cwist_http_header_add_ex(head, NULL, key, value);
1562}
1563
1570char *cwist_http_header_get(cwist_http_header_node *head, const char *key) {
1571 if (!head || !key) return NULL;
1572 size_t klen = strlen(key);
1573 cwist_http_header_node *curr = head;
1574 while (curr) {
1575 if (curr->key && curr->key->data && curr->key->size == klen) {
1576 if (strcasecmp(curr->key->data, key) == 0) {
1577 return curr->value ? curr->value->data : NULL;
1578 }
1579 }
1580 curr = curr->next;
1581 }
1582 return NULL;
1583}
1584
1597size_t cwist_http_header_remove(cwist_http_header_node **head, const char *key) {
1598 if (!head || !key) return 0;
1599 size_t removed = 0;
1600 while (*head) {
1601 cwist_http_header_node *node = *head;
1602 if (node->key && node->key->data && strcasecmp(node->key->data, key) == 0) {
1603 *head = node->next;
1604 cwist_sstring_destroy(node->key);
1605 cwist_sstring_destroy(node->value);
1606 if (!node->arena_owned) cwist_free(node);
1607 removed++;
1608 } else {
1609 head = &node->next;
1610 }
1611 }
1612 return removed;
1613}

1625void cwist_http_response_add_security_headers(cwist_http_response *res) {
1626 if (!res) return;
1627 cwist_arena_t *arena = (cwist_arena_t *)res->arena;
1628
1629 /* All key/value pairs are compile-time constants: borrow them instead of
1630 * heap-copying, so a default response performs zero heap allocations for
1631 * its security headers (arena carve only). */
1632 if (!cwist_http_header_get(res->headers, "X-Frame-Options")) {
1633 cwist_http_header_add_static(&res->headers, arena, "X-Frame-Options", "DENY");
1634 }
1635 if (!cwist_http_header_get(res->headers, "X-Content-Type-Options")) {
1636 cwist_http_header_add_static(&res->headers, arena, "X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
1637 }
1638 if (!cwist_http_header_get(res->headers, "Referrer-Policy")) {
1639 cwist_http_header_add_static(&res->headers, arena, "Referrer-Policy",
1640 "strict-origin-when-cross-origin");
1641 }
1642 if (!cwist_http_header_get(res->headers, "Content-Security-Policy")) {
1643 cwist_http_header_add_static(
1644 &res->headers, arena, "Content-Security-Policy",
1645 "default-src 'self'; "
1646 "script-src 'self' https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com; "
1647 "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com https://cdn.jsdelivr.net https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com; "
1648 "font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; "
1649 "img-src 'self'; "
1650 "connect-src 'self'; "
1651 "frame-ancestors 'none'; "
1652 "base-uri 'self'; "
1653 "form-action 'self'; "
1654 "object-src 'none';");
1655 }
1656 if (!cwist_http_header_get(res->headers, "Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy")) {
1657 cwist_http_header_add_static(&res->headers, arena, "Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy",
1658 "same-origin");
1659 }
1660 /* Permissions-Policy (W3C Permissions Policy Level 2) — deny access to
1661 * sensitive browser APIs that CWIST apps almost never need. Callers that
1662 * require a specific feature can set the header before calling this
1663 * function; the existing-header check below will skip the default. */
1664 if (!cwist_http_header_get(res->headers, "Permissions-Policy")) {
1665 cwist_http_header_add_static(&res->headers, arena, "Permissions-Policy",
1666 "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), "
1667 "usb=(), interest-cohort=()");
1668 }
1669 if (!cwist_http_header_get(res->headers, "Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy")) {
1670 cwist_http_header_add_static(&res->headers, arena, "Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy",
1671 "same-origin");
1672 }
1673}
1674
1684void cwist_http_response_add_hsts(cwist_http_response *res) {
1685 if (!res) return;
1686 cwist_arena_t *arena = (cwist_arena_t *)res->arena;
1687 if (!cwist_http_header_get(res->headers, "Strict-Transport-Security")) {
1688 cwist_http_header_add_static(&res->headers, arena, "Strict-Transport-Security",
1689 "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains");
1690 }
1691}
1692
1697void cwist_http_header_free_all(cwist_http_header_node *head) {
1698 cwist_http_header_node *curr = head;
1699 while (curr) {
1700 cwist_http_header_node *next = curr->next;
1701 cwist_sstring_destroy(curr->key);
1702 cwist_sstring_destroy(curr->value);
1703 if (!curr->arena_owned) {
1704 cwist_free(curr);
1705 }
1706 curr = next;
1707 }
1708}

1714static void cwist_get_cached_date_header(char out_buf[36]) {
1715 static _Atomic time_t g_last_sec = 0;
1716 static char g_date_str[36] = {0};
1717 static pthread_mutex_t g_date_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
1718
1719 time_t now = time(NULL);
1720 time_t last = atomic_load_explicit(&g_last_sec, memory_order_relaxed);
1721 if (now != last) {
1722 pthread_mutex_lock(&g_date_lock);
1723 if (now != atomic_load_explicit(&g_last_sec, memory_order_relaxed)) {
1724 struct tm gmt;
1725#if defined(_WIN32)
1726 gmtime_s(&gmt, &now);
1727#else
1728 gmtime_r(&now, &gmt);
1729#endif
1730 strftime(g_date_str, sizeof(g_date_str), "%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S GMT", &gmt);
1731 atomic_store_explicit(&g_last_sec, now, memory_order_release);
1732 }
1733 pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_date_lock);
1734 }
1735 memcpy(out_buf, g_date_str, 30);
1736 out_buf[29] = '\0';
1737}

1745cwist_http_request *cwist_http_request_create(void) {
1746 cwist_arena_t *arena = cwist_arena_create(0);
1747 cwist_http_request *req =
1748 (cwist_http_request *)cwist_http_struct_alloc(arena, sizeof(cwist_http_request));
1749 if (!req) {
1750 cwist_arena_destroy(arena);
1751 return NULL;
1752 }
1753
1754 req->method = CWIST_HTTP_GET; // Default
1755 req->path = cwist_http_sstring_create(arena);
1756 req->query = cwist_http_sstring_create(arena);
1757 req->query_params = NULL;
1758 req->path_params = NULL;
1759 req->version = cwist_http_sstring_create(arena);
1760 req->headers = NULL;
1761 req->body = cwist_http_sstring_create(arena);
1762 req->keep_alive = true;
1763 req->client_fd = -1;
1764 req->app = NULL;
1765 req->db = NULL;
1766 req->flash = NULL;
1767 req->upgraded = false;
1768 req->content_length = 0;
1769 req->stream_id = 0;
1770 req->private_data = NULL;
1771 req->endpoint_opts = CWIST_ENDPOINT_DEFAULT;
1772 req->arena = arena;
1773 req->async_conn = NULL;
1774 req->https_conn = NULL;
1775 req->h2_queue = NULL;
1776
1777 // Defaults (borrowed statics; parsing overwrites them via arena/heap assign)
1778 cwist_sstring_borrow(req->version, "HTTP/1.1", 8);
1779 cwist_sstring_borrow(req->path, "/", 1);
1780
1781 return req;
1782}

1797void cwist_http_format_date(time_t t, char *buf, size_t len) {
1798 struct tm tm;
1799 gmtime_r(&t, &tm);
1800 strftime(buf, len, "%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S GMT", &tm);
1801}

1808time_t cwist_http_parse_date(const char *str) {
1809 if (!str) return (time_t)-1;
1810 struct tm tm = {0};
1811 const char *fmt = "%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %Z";
1812 if (strptime(str, fmt, &tm) == NULL) {
1813 // Try alternative formats
1814 fmt = "%a, %d-%b-%y %H:%M:%S %Z";
1815 if (strptime(str, fmt, &tm) == NULL) {
1816 fmt = "%a %b %d %H:%M:%S %Y";
1817 if (strptime(str, fmt, &tm) == NULL) {
1818 return (time_t)-1;
1819 }
1820 }
1821 }
1822 return timegm(&tm);
1823}

1830cwist_sstring *cwist_get_client_ip_from_fd(int fd) {
1831 cwist_sstring *s = cwist_sstring_create();
1832 cwist_sstring_assign(s, "127.0.0.1");
1833 // First, check if fd is available
1834 // If unavailable, return localhost
1835 if (fd <= 0) return s;
1836
1837#ifndef CWIST_WASI_NO_SOCKETS
1838 /* WASI preview1 has no socket peer addresses; the caller only needs a
1839 * placeholder when running under a WASM host. */
1840 struct sockaddr_storage addr;
1841 socklen_t len = sizeof(addr);
1842
1843 // get client info
1844 if (getpeername(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, &len) == -1) {
1845 fprintf(stdout, "[ERROR] Failed to get client info from file descriptor");
1846 return s;
1847 }
1848
1849 char ip[INET6_ADDRSTRLEN];
1850
1851 if (addr.ss_family == AF_INET) {
1852 struct sockaddr_in *s = (struct sockaddr_in *)&addr;
1853 inet_ntop(AF_INET, &s->sin_addr, ip, sizeof(ip));
1854 } else if (addr.ss_family == AF_INET6) {
1855 struct sockaddr_in6 *s = (struct sockaddr_in6 *)&addr;
1856 inet_ntop(AF_INET6, &s->sin6_addr, ip, sizeof(ip));
1857 }
1858
1859 // assign found ip as a value
1860 cwist_sstring_assign(s, ip);
1861#endif
1862 return s;
1863}

1869void cwist_http_request_destroy(cwist_http_request *req) {
1870 if (req) {
1871 cwist_arena_t *arena = (cwist_arena_t *)req->arena;
1872 cwist_sstring_destroy(req->path);
1873 cwist_sstring_destroy(req->query);
1874 cwist_query_map_destroy(req->query_params);
1875 cwist_query_map_destroy(req->path_params);
1876 cwist_sstring_destroy(req->version);
1877 cwist_sstring_destroy(req->body);
1878 cwist_query_map_destroy(req->flash);
1879 cwist_session_destroy(req->session);
1880 cwist_free(req->csrf_token);
1881 cwist_http_header_free_all(req->headers);
1882 if (!arena || !cwist_arena_owns(arena, req)) {
1883 cwist_free(req);
1884 }
1885 /* Releases every arena-carved struct (request, sstrings, header
1886 * nodes) in one shot; heap-owned buffers were freed above. */
1887 cwist_arena_destroy(arena);
1888 }
1889}

1897static void cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(cwist_http_response *res) {
1898 if (!res || !res->use_file_stream) return;
1899 if (res->file_stream_auto_close && res->file_stream_fd >= 0) {
1900 close(res->file_stream_fd);
1901 }
1902 res->use_file_stream = false;
1903 res->file_stream_fd = -1;
1904 res->file_stream_len = 0;
1905 res->file_stream_offset = 0;
1906 res->file_stream_auto_close = false;
1907}

1913static void cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(cwist_http_response *res) {
1914 if (!res || !res->is_ptr_body) return;
1915 if (res->ptr_body_cleanup && res->ptr_body) {
1916 res->ptr_body_cleanup(res->ptr_body, res->ptr_body_len, res->ptr_body_cleanup_ctx);
1917 }
1918 res->is_ptr_body = false;
1919 res->ptr_body = NULL;
1920 res->ptr_body_len = 0;
1921 res->ptr_body_cleanup = NULL;
1922 res->ptr_body_cleanup_ctx = NULL;
1923}

1935static cwist_http_response *cwist_http_response_create_impl(cwist_arena_t *arena,
1936 bool arena_borrowed) {
1937 cwist_http_response *res =
1938 (cwist_http_response *)cwist_http_struct_alloc(arena, sizeof(cwist_http_response));
1939 if (!res) return NULL;
1940
1941 res->version = cwist_http_sstring_create(arena);
1942 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_OK;
1943 res->status_text = cwist_http_sstring_create(arena);
1944 res->headers = NULL;
1945 res->body = cwist_http_sstring_create(arena);
1946 res->endpoint_opts = CWIST_ENDPOINT_DEFAULT;
1947 res->keep_alive = true;
1948 res->is_ptr_body = false;
1949 res->ptr_body = NULL;
1950 res->ptr_body_len = 0;
1951 res->ptr_body_cleanup = NULL;
1952 res->ptr_body_cleanup_ctx = NULL;
1953 res->use_file_stream = false;
1954 res->file_stream_fd = -1;
1955 res->file_stream_len = 0;
1956 res->file_stream_offset = 0;
1957 res->file_stream_auto_close = false;
1958 res->stream_mode = false;
1959 res->stream_ended = false;
1960 res->stream_failed = false;
1961 res->stream_buf = cwist_http_sstring_create(arena);
1962 res->stream_flushed = 0;
1963 res->stream_sink = NULL;
1964 res->stream_sink_ctx = NULL;
1965 res->stream_head_sent = false;
1966 res->arena = arena;
1967 res->arena_borrowed = arena_borrowed;
1968
1969 // Defaults (borrowed statics; handlers may overwrite via regular assign)
1970 cwist_sstring_borrow(res->version, "HTTP/1.1", 8);
1971 cwist_sstring_borrow(res->status_text, "OK", 2);
1972
1973 return res;
1974}

2004void cwist_http_response_destroy(cwist_http_response *res) {
2005 if (res) {
2006 cwist_arena_t *arena = (cwist_arena_t *)res->arena;
2007 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
2008 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
2009 cwist_sstring_destroy(res->version);
2010 cwist_sstring_destroy(res->status_text);
2011 cwist_sstring_destroy(res->body);
2012 cwist_sstring_destroy(res->stream_buf);
2013 cwist_http_header_free_all(res->headers);
2014 cwist_free(res->alt_svc);
2015 /* Snapshot before the possible free: when the arena was full the
2016 * struct fell back to the heap, so res may be freed below and any
2017 * later field read is a use-after-free. */
2018 bool borrowed = res->arena_borrowed;
2019 if (!arena || !cwist_arena_owns(arena, res)) {
2020 cwist_free(res);
2021 }
2022 if (!borrowed) {
2023 cwist_arena_destroy(arena);
2024 }
2025 }
2026}

2100static size_t serialize_headers(cwist_http_response *res, char *buf, size_t buf_size) {
2101 size_t body_len = 0;
2102 if (res->use_file_stream) {
2103 body_len = res->file_stream_len;
2104 } else if (res->is_ptr_body) {
2105 body_len = res->ptr_body_len;
2106 } else if (res->body) {
2107 body_len = res->body->size;
2108 }
2109
2110 /* Fast path for default HTTP/1.1 200 OK response with no custom headers.
2111 * Streamed responses take the general path: chunked mode needs the
2112 * Transfer-Encoding header the fast path cannot emit. */
2113 if (res->status_code == 200 && !res->headers && !res->alt_svc && !res->stream_mode &&
2114 buf_size >= 128) {
2115 /* Compact ring/line buffer optimization for high-throughput pipelining */
2116 static const char status_prefix[] = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: ";
2117 memcpy(buf, status_prefix, sizeof(status_prefix) - 1);
2118 size_t offset = sizeof(status_prefix) - 1;
2119
2120 /* Fast integer to ascii without snprintf overhead */
2121 char num_buf[20];
2122 char *p = num_buf + sizeof(num_buf);
2123 size_t tmp_len = body_len;
2124 do {
2125 *--p = '0' + (tmp_len % 10);
2126 tmp_len /= 10;
2127 } while (tmp_len > 0);
2128 size_t num_len = (num_buf + sizeof(num_buf)) - p;
2129 memcpy(buf + offset, p, num_len);
2130 offset += num_len;
2131
2132 if (res->keep_alive) {
2133 static const char conn_ka[] = "\r\nConnection: keep-alive\r\n\r\n";
2134 memcpy(buf + offset, conn_ka, sizeof(conn_ka) - 1);
2135 offset += sizeof(conn_ka) - 1;
2136 } else {
2137 static const char conn_cl[] = "\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n";
2138 memcpy(buf + offset, conn_cl, sizeof(conn_cl) - 1);
2139 offset += sizeof(conn_cl) - 1;
2140 }
2141 return offset;
2142 }
2143
2144 size_t offset = 0;
2145
2146 // Status Line
2147 const char *status_txt =
2148 (res->status_text && res->status_text->data) ? res->status_text->data : NULL;
2149 /* Default status_text is the borrowed "OK"; when a handler only changed
2150 * the numeric code, emit the standard reason phrase for that code. */
2151 if (!status_txt || (res->status_code != CWIST_HTTP_OK && strcmp(status_txt, "OK") == 0)) {
2152 const char *reason = cwist_http_status_reason(res->status_code);
2153 if (reason) status_txt = reason;
2154 }
2155 if (!status_txt) status_txt = "OK";
2156 /* Hand-rolled status line (version SP code SP reason CRLF): snprintf
2157 * here showed up hot because every non-fast-path response pays it. */
2158 {
2159 const char *version =
2160 (res->version && res->version->data) ? res->version->data : "HTTP/1.1";
2161 const size_t vlen = strlen(version);
2162 const size_t rlen = strlen(status_txt);
2163 unsigned int code = (unsigned int)res->status_code;
2164 char code_buf[10];
2165 char *cp = code_buf + sizeof(code_buf);
2166 do {
2167 *--cp = (char)('0' + (code % 10));
2168 code /= 10;
2169 } while (code > 0);
2170 const size_t code_len = (size_t)(code_buf + sizeof(code_buf) - cp);
2171 if (offset + vlen + 1 + code_len + 1 + rlen + 2 <= buf_size) {
2172 memcpy(buf + offset, version, vlen);
2173 offset += vlen;
2174 buf[offset++] = ' ';
2175 memcpy(buf + offset, cp, code_len);
2176 offset += code_len;
2177 buf[offset++] = ' ';
2178 memcpy(buf + offset, status_txt, rlen);
2179 offset += rlen;
2180 buf[offset++] = '\r';
2181 buf[offset++] = '\n';
2182 }
2183 }
2184
2185 // Headers: memcpy with known sstring lengths (no snprintf/strlen overhead),
2186 // detecting Date/Content-Length/Connection in the same single pass with a
2187 // length + first-byte filter before falling back to strcasecmp.
2188 bool have_date = false, have_clen = false, have_conn = false, have_te = false;
2189 cwist_http_header_node *curr = res->headers;
2190 while (curr) {
2191 if (curr->key->data && curr->value->data) {
2192 size_t klen = curr->key->size;
2193 size_t vlen = curr->value->size;
2194 if (offset + klen + 2 + vlen + 2 <= buf_size) {
2195 memcpy(buf + offset, curr->key->data, klen);
2196 buf[offset + klen] = ':';
2197 buf[offset + klen + 1] = ' ';
2198 memcpy(buf + offset + klen + 2, curr->value->data, vlen);
2199 buf[offset + klen + 2 + vlen] = '\r';
2200 buf[offset + klen + 2 + vlen + 1] = '\n';
2201 offset += klen + vlen + 4;
2202 }
2203 char k0 = curr->key->data[0];
2204 if (klen == 4 && (k0 == 'D' || k0 == 'd')) {
2205 if (strcasecmp(curr->key->data, "date") == 0) have_date = true;
2206 } else if (klen == 14 && (k0 == 'C' || k0 == 'c')) {
2207 if (strcasecmp(curr->key->data, "content-length") == 0) have_clen = true;
2208 } else if (klen == 10 && (k0 == 'C' || k0 == 'c')) {
2209 if (strcasecmp(curr->key->data, "connection") == 0) have_conn = true;
2210 } else if (klen == 17 && (k0 == 'T' || k0 == 't')) {
2211 if (strcasecmp(curr->key->data, "transfer-encoding") == 0) have_te = true;
2212 }
2213 }
2214 curr = curr->next;
2215 }
2216
2217 if (!have_date && offset + 37 <= buf_size) {
2218 char date_str[36];
2219 cwist_get_cached_date_header(date_str); /* 29 bytes, NUL-terminated */
2220 memcpy(buf + offset, "Date: ", 6);
2221 memcpy(buf + offset + 6, date_str, 29);
2222 buf[offset + 35] = '\r';
2223 buf[offset + 36] = '\n';
2224 offset += 37;
2225 }
2226
2227 if (res->stream_mode && !have_te && !have_clen) {
2228 static const char te_chunked[] = "Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n";
2229 if (offset + sizeof(te_chunked) - 1 <= buf_size) {
2230 memcpy(buf + offset, te_chunked, sizeof(te_chunked) - 1);
2231 offset += sizeof(te_chunked) - 1;
2232 }
2233 }
2234
2235 if (!have_clen && !res->stream_mode) {
2236 /* Fast integer to ascii without snprintf overhead */
2237 char num_buf[20];
2238 char *p = num_buf + sizeof(num_buf);
2239 size_t tmp_len = body_len;
2240 do {
2241 *--p = '0' + (tmp_len % 10);
2242 tmp_len /= 10;
2243 } while (tmp_len > 0);
2244 size_t num_len = (size_t)((num_buf + sizeof(num_buf)) - p);
2245 if (offset + 16 + num_len + 2 <= buf_size) {
2246 memcpy(buf + offset, "Content-Length: ", 16);
2247 memcpy(buf + offset + 16, p, num_len);
2248 buf[offset + 16 + num_len] = '\r';
2249 buf[offset + 16 + num_len + 1] = '\n';
2250 offset += 16 + num_len + 2;
2251 }
2252 }
2253
2254 if (!have_conn) {
2255 if (res->keep_alive) {
2256 static const char conn_ka[] = "Connection: keep-alive\r\n";
2257 if (offset + sizeof(conn_ka) - 1 <= buf_size) {
2258 memcpy(buf + offset, conn_ka, sizeof(conn_ka) - 1);
2259 offset += sizeof(conn_ka) - 1;
2260 }
2261 } else {
2262 static const char conn_cl[] = "Connection: close\r\n";
2263 if (offset + sizeof(conn_cl) - 1 <= buf_size) {
2264 memcpy(buf + offset, conn_cl, sizeof(conn_cl) - 1);
2265 offset += sizeof(conn_cl) - 1;
2266 }
2267 }
2268 }
2269
2270 if (res->alt_svc) {
2271 if (offset < buf_size) {
2272 int n = snprintf(buf + offset, buf_size - offset, "Alt-Svc: %s\r\n", res->alt_svc);
2273 if (n > 0) {
2274 offset += n;
2275 if (offset > buf_size) offset = buf_size;
2276 }
2277 }
2278 }
2279
2280 if (offset + 2 <= buf_size) {
2281 buf[offset++] = '\r';
2282 buf[offset++] = '\n';
2283 }
2284 return offset;
2285}
2286
2298size_t cwist_http_serialize_headers(cwist_http_response *res, char *buf, size_t buf_size) {
2299 return serialize_headers(res, buf, buf_size);
2300}

2302#include <sys/uio.h> // For writev and BSD sendfile
2303
2304/* --- Optional TCP_CORK coalescing layer (cleartext HTTP/1.1) -------------
2305 * Enabled at runtime with CWIST_USE_TCP_CORK=1, no source changes needed.
2306 * While corked, headers + body + file bytes accumulate into full segments;
2307 * instead of flushing everything in one giant clump, the file path flushes
2308 * every CWIST_TCP_CORK_BURST bytes (default 256 KiB), which is what keeps
2309 * high-RTT links fed without head-of-queue clumping. TLS is unaffected
2310 * (records are sealed above the TCP layer, so cork buys nothing there). */
2311#if defined(__linux__) && defined(TCP_CORK)
2312#define CWIST_TCP_CORK_DEFAULT_BURST (256 * 1024)
2313
2319bool cwist_tcp_cork_enabled(void) {
2320 static int enabled = -1; /* benign idempotent race on first use */
2321 if (enabled < 0) {
2322 const char *env = getenv("CWIST_USE_TCP_CORK");
2323 if (env && *env) {
2324 char *end = NULL;
2325 long v = strtol(env, &end, 10);
2326 enabled = (end != env && *end == '\0' && v > 0) ? 1 : 0;
2327 } else {
2328 enabled = 0;
2329 }
2330 }
2331 return enabled == 1;
2332}
2333
2338static size_t cwist_tcp_cork_burst(void) {
2339 static size_t burst = 0;
2340 if (burst == 0) {
2341 const char *env = getenv("CWIST_TCP_CORK_BURST");
2342 long v = 0;
2343 if (env && *env) {
2344 char *end = NULL;
2345 long tmp = strtol(env, &end, 10);
2346 if (end != env && *end == '\0') v = tmp;
2347 }
2348 burst = (v >= 16384) ? (size_t)v : (size_t)CWIST_TCP_CORK_DEFAULT_BURST;
2349 }
2350 return burst;
2351}
2352
2357static int cwist_tcp_cork_set(int fd, bool on) {
2358 int v = on ? 1 : 0;
2359 return setsockopt(fd, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_CORK, &v, sizeof(v));
2360}
2361
2363static void cwist_tcp_cork_flush(int fd) {
2364 cwist_tcp_cork_set(fd, false);
2365 cwist_tcp_cork_set(fd, true);
2366}
2367#else
2372bool cwist_tcp_cork_enabled(void) {
2373 return false;
2374}
2375#endif
