2382static int cwist_http_sendmsg_all(int fd, struct iovec *iov, int iovcnt, int flags) {
2383#ifdef CWIST_WASI_SOCKETS
2384 /* wasi:sockets (0.2) has no sendmsg(2): coalesce the iov into a single
2385 * buffer and drive plain send(). Response iovs are small (headers + one
2386 * body segment), so the copy is cheap. */
2387 size_t total = 0;
2388 for (int i = 0; i < iovcnt; i++) total += iov[i].iov_len;
2389 char *buf = cwist_alloc(total ? total : 1);
2390 if (!buf) return -1;
2391 size_t off = 0;
2392 for (int i = 0; i < iovcnt; i++) {
2393 memcpy(buf + off, iov[i].iov_base, iov[i].iov_len);
2394 off += iov[i].iov_len;
2395 }
2396 size_t sent = 0;
2397 int rc = -1;
2398 while (sent < total) {
2399 ssize_t n = send(fd, buf + sent, total - sent, flags);
2400 if (n < 0) {
2401 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
2402 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
2403 struct pollfd pfd = {.fd = fd, .events = POLLOUT};
2404 int pr = poll(&pfd, 1, CWIST_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS);
2405 if (pr <= 0) goto wasi_done;
2406 if (pfd.revents & (POLLERR | POLLHUP | POLLNVAL)) goto wasi_done;
2407 continue;
2408 }
2409 goto wasi_done;
2410 }
2411 if (n == 0) goto wasi_done;
2412 sent += (size_t)n;
2413 }
2414 rc = 0;
2415wasi_done:
2416 cwist_free(buf);
2417 return rc;
2418#elif !defined(CWIST_WASI_NO_SOCKETS)
2419 /* Speculative zero-latency fast-path attempt:
2420 * Completes immediately for non-saturated sockets without entering poll() loops. */
2421 size_t fast_sent = 0;
2422 cwist_write_status_t fast_st =
2423 cwist_http_sendmsg_speculative(fd, iov, iovcnt, flags, &fast_sent);
2424 if (fast_st == CWIST_WRITE_DONE) {
2425 return 0;
2426 } else if (fast_st == CWIST_WRITE_ERR) {
2427 return -1;
2428 }
2429
2430 struct iovec *cur = iov;
2431 int curcnt = iovcnt;
2432
2433 /* Advance by bytes already sent in fast-path attempt */
2434 while (curcnt > 0 && fast_sent >= cur->iov_len) {
2435 fast_sent -= cur->iov_len;
2436 cur++;
2437 curcnt--;
2438 }
2439 if (curcnt > 0 && fast_sent > 0) {
2440 cur->iov_base = (char *)cur->iov_base + fast_sent;
2441 cur->iov_len -= fast_sent;
2442 }
2443
2444 while (curcnt > 0) {
2445 struct msghdr msg = {0};
2446 msg.msg_iov = cur;
2447 msg.msg_iovlen = (size_t)curcnt;
2448 ssize_t n = sendmsg(fd, &msg, flags);
2449 if (n < 0) {
2450 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
2451 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
2452 struct pollfd pfd = {.fd = fd, .events = POLLOUT};
2453 int ret = poll(&pfd, 1, CWIST_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS);
2454 if (ret <= 0) return -1;
2455 if (pfd.revents & (POLLERR | POLLHUP | POLLNVAL)) return -1;
2456 continue;
2457 }
2458 return -1;
2459 }
2460 if (n == 0) return -1;
2461
2462 while (curcnt > 0 && (size_t)n >= cur->iov_len) {
2463 n -= (ssize_t)cur->iov_len;
2464 cur++;
2465 curcnt--;
2466 }
2467 if (curcnt > 0) {
2468 cur->iov_base = (char *)cur->iov_base + n;
2469 cur->iov_len -= (size_t)n;
2470 }
2471 }
2472 return 0;
2473#else
2474 /* WASI preview1 has no sockets; sending is impossible. Callers treat
2475 * this as a write error and tear the connection down. */
2476 (void)fd;
2477 (void)iov;
2478 (void)iovcnt;
2479 (void)flags;
2480 return -1;
2481#endif
2482}
2483
2490static bool cwist_http_stream_file_fast(int client_fd, cwist_http_response *res) {
2491 if (!res || !res->use_file_stream || res->file_stream_fd < 0) return false;
2492 size_t remaining = res->file_stream_len;
2493 off_t offset = res->file_stream_offset;
2494#if defined(__linux__)
2495 const bool cork = cwist_tcp_cork_enabled();
2496 const size_t burst = cork ? cwist_tcp_cork_burst() : 0;
2497 size_t since_flush = 0;
2498#endif
2499 while (remaining > 0) {
2500#if defined(__linux__)
2501 /* Cap each sendfile at the remaining burst budget so flushes land on
2502 * moderate boundaries instead of one giant clump. */
2503 size_t quota = remaining;
2504 if (cork && burst - since_flush < quota) quota = burst - since_flush;
2505 ssize_t sent = sendfile(client_fd, res->file_stream_fd, &offset, quota);
2506 if (sent < 0) {
2507 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
2508 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
2509 struct pollfd pfd = {.fd = client_fd, .events = POLLOUT};
2510 int ret = poll(&pfd, 1, CWIST_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS);
2511 if (ret <= 0 || (pfd.revents & (POLLERR | POLLHUP | POLLNVAL))) return false;
2512 continue;
2513 }
2514 return false;
2515 }
2516 if (sent == 0) break;
2517 remaining -= (size_t)sent;
2518 if (cork) {
2519 since_flush += (size_t)sent;
2520 if (since_flush >= burst && remaining > 0) {
2521 cwist_tcp_cork_flush(client_fd);
2522 since_flush = 0;
2523 }
2524 }
2525#else
2526 /* Portable read+write fallback for macOS, FreeBSD, and other platforms.
2527 lseek is used to handle the offset since pread avoids modifying the
2528 file descriptor's position across calls. */
2529 char buf[65536];
2530 size_t to_read = remaining < sizeof(buf) ? remaining : sizeof(buf);
2531 ssize_t n = pread(res->file_stream_fd, buf, to_read, offset);
2532 if (n < 0) {
2533 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
2534 return false;
2535 }
2536 if (n == 0) break;
2537 ssize_t nw = 0;
2538 while (nw < n) {
2539 ssize_t w = write(client_fd, buf + nw, (size_t)(n - nw));
2540 if (w < 0) {
2541 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
2542 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
2543 struct pollfd pfd = {.fd = client_fd, .events = POLLOUT};
2544 int ret = poll(&pfd, 1, CWIST_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS);
2545 if (ret <= 0 || (pfd.revents & (POLLERR | POLLHUP | POLLNVAL))) return false;
2546 continue;
2547 }
2548 return false;
2549 }
2550 nw += w;
2551 }
2552 offset += nw;
2553 remaining -= (size_t)nw;
2554#endif
2555 }
2556 res->file_stream_offset = offset;
2557 return remaining == 0;
2558}
2559
2566cwist_error_t cwist_http_send_response(int client_fd, cwist_http_response *res) {
2567 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
2568
2569 if (client_fd < 0 || !res) {
2570 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
2571 return err;
2572 }
2573
2574 // 1. Prepare Headers (On Stack)
2575 char header_buf[CWIST_HTTP_MAX_HEADER_SIZE];
2576 size_t header_len = serialize_headers(res, header_buf, sizeof(header_buf));
2577
2578 // 2. Prepare Body
2579 const void *body_ptr = NULL;
2580 size_t body_len = 0;
2581
2582 if (res->is_ptr_body) {
2583 body_ptr = res->ptr_body;
2584 body_len = res->ptr_body_len;
2585 } else if (res->body && res->body->data) {
2586 body_ptr = res->body->data;
2587 body_len = res->body->size;
2588 }
2589
2590 // 3. sendmsg (Scatter/Gather + Flags) - Zero Copy Send
2591 struct iovec iov[2];
2592 int iov_cnt = 1;
2593
2594 iov[0].iov_base = header_buf;
2595 iov[0].iov_len = header_len;
2596
2597 if (!res->use_file_stream && body_len > 0 && body_ptr) {
2598 iov[1].iov_base = (void *)body_ptr;
2599 iov[1].iov_len = body_len;
2600 iov_cnt = 2;
2601 }
2602
2603 int flags = 0;
2604#if defined(MSG_NOSIGNAL)
2605 flags |= MSG_NOSIGNAL;
2606#endif
2607#if defined(MSG_DONTWAIT)
2608 flags |= MSG_DONTWAIT;
2609#endif
2610
2611#if defined(__linux__) && defined(TCP_CORK)
2612 const bool cork = cwist_tcp_cork_enabled();
2613 if (cork) {
2614 cwist_tcp_cork_set(client_fd, true);
2615#if defined(MSG_MORE)
2616 /* File body follows: let the headers merge with the first burst. */
2617 if (res->use_file_stream) flags |= MSG_MORE;
2618#endif
2619 }
2620#endif
2621
2622 if (cwist_http_sendmsg_all(client_fd, iov, iov_cnt, flags) != 0) {
2623 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
2624 } else {
2625 err.error.err_i16 = 0;
2626 if (res->use_file_stream) {
2627 if (!cwist_http_stream_file_fast(client_fd, res)) {
2628 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
2629 }
2630 }
2631 }
2632
2633#if defined(__linux__) && defined(TCP_CORK)
2634 /* Uncorking flushes the final partial burst; runs on every outcome so a
2635 * failed send can never leave the socket corked. */
2636 if (cork) cwist_tcp_cork_set(client_fd, false);
2637#endif
2638
2639 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
2640 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
2641 return err;
2642}
2643
2649cwist_error_t cwist_http_send_response_head(int client_fd, cwist_http_response *res) {
2650 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
2651 if (client_fd < 0 || !res) {
2652 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
2653 return err;
2654 }
2655
2656 char header_buf[CWIST_HTTP_MAX_HEADER_SIZE];
2657 size_t header_len = serialize_headers(res, header_buf, sizeof(header_buf));
2658
2659 struct iovec iov = {.iov_base = header_buf, .iov_len = header_len};
2660 int flags = 0;
2661#if defined(MSG_NOSIGNAL)
2662 flags |= MSG_NOSIGNAL;
2663#endif
2664#if defined(MSG_DONTWAIT)
2665 flags |= MSG_DONTWAIT;
2666#endif
2667
2668 err.error.err_i16 = (cwist_http_sendmsg_all(client_fd, &iov, 1, flags) == 0) ? 0 : -1;
2669
2670 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
2671 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
2672 return err;
2673}
2674
2675/* --- Parked (POLLOUT-resumable) deferred-response writer --------------------
2676 * A deferred completion on the reactor path must never block the reactor
2677 * thread in the poll(POLLOUT) fallback of cwist_http_sendmsg_all. When the
2678 * speculative sendmsg cannot drain the whole response, the unsent remainder
2679 * is deep-copied into an owned buffer (req/res/the arena are freed right
2680 * after the handoff) and parked on a one-shot write-readiness slot; each
2681 * POLLOUT event resumes the send, and the final event re-arms keep-alive or
2682 * closes exactly like the synchronous completion. The slot payload carries
2683 * everything the callback needs, so no extra heap struct is required. */
2684
2685typedef struct {
2686 int file_fd; /* sendfile source (Linux file mode). */
2687 off_t file_off;
2688 size_t file_left;
2689 bool close_file_fd; /* file_fd is our dup() and must be closed. */
2690 const char *body; /* Referenced pointer body (BODYREF mode). */
2691 size_t body_off;
2692 size_t body_left;
2693 cwist_http_body_cleanup_fn body_cleanup; /* Runs once at park finish. */
2694 void *body_cleanup_ctx;
2695} http_parked_write_state_t;
2696
2697enum {
2698 HTTP_PARK_INLINE = 0, /* w.buf holds the full unsent remainder. */
2699 HTTP_PARK_FILE, /* w.buf holds unsent headers; state->file streams. */
2700 HTTP_PARK_BODYREF, /* w.buf holds unsent headers; state->body references. */
2701};
2702
2703typedef struct {
2704 cwist_reactor_t *reactor;
2705 cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn;
2706 char *buf; /* Owned copy of the unsent header bytes (all modes). */
2707 size_t off;
2708 size_t len;
2709 http_parked_write_state_t *state; /* Heap state for FILE/BODYREF modes. */
2710 uint32_t deadline_sec; /* Absolute write deadline (monotonic sec). */
2711 uint8_t mode;
2712 bool keep_alive;
2713} http_parked_write_t;
2714
2715_Static_assert(sizeof(http_parked_write_t) <= CWIST_REACTOR_PAYLOAD_SIZE,
2716 "parked write state must fit a reactor slot payload");
2717
2721static uint32_t http_parked_write_deadline(void) {
2722 return cwist_fast_monotonic_sec() + cwist_http_keep_alive_timeout_sec();
2723}
2724
2725static void http_parked_write_cb(int fd, void *ctx);
2726
2727/* Re-park on a fresh one-shot POLLOUT slot; the slot copies the payload and
2728 * ownership of buf/state moves with it. False means the caller must finish. */
2734static bool http_parked_rearm(int fd, http_parked_write_t *w) {
2735 return cwist_fast_monotonic_sec() <= w->deadline_sec &&
2736 cwist_reactor_add_out(w->reactor, fd, http_parked_write_cb, w, sizeof(*w));
2737}
2738
2745static void http_parked_write_finish(int fd, http_parked_write_t *w, bool drained) {
2746 cwist_reactor_t *reactor = w->reactor;
2747 cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn = w->conn;
2748 bool keep = w->keep_alive && drained && atomic_load(&g_cwist_running);
2749 cwist_free(w->buf);
2750 if (w->state) {
2751#if defined(__linux__)
2752 if (w->state->close_file_fd && w->state->file_fd >= 0) close(w->state->file_fd);
2753#endif
2754 if (w->state->body_cleanup && w->state->body) {
2755 size_t total = w->state->body_off + w->state->body_left;
2756 w->state->body_cleanup((void *)w->state->body, total, w->state->body_cleanup_ctx);
2757 }
2758 cwist_free(w->state);
2759 }
2760 if (keep) {
2761 cwist_http_async_rearm(fd, reactor, conn);
2762 } else {
2763 http_async_close(fd, conn);
2764 }
2765}
2766
2775static void http_parked_write_cb(int fd, void *ctx) {
2776 http_parked_write_t *w = (http_parked_write_t *)ctx;
2777 int flags = 0;
2778#if defined(MSG_NOSIGNAL)
2779 flags |= MSG_NOSIGNAL;
2780#endif
2781#if defined(MSG_DONTWAIT)
2782 flags |= MSG_DONTWAIT;
2783#endif
2784
2785 /* Unsent header bytes drain first in every mode. */
2786 while (w->off < w->len) {
2787 ssize_t n = send(fd, w->buf + w->off, w->len - w->off, flags);
2788 if (n > 0) {
2789 w->off += (size_t)n;
2790 /* Progress resets the budget so a slow-but-alive client can
2791 * drain a large body; a silent peer hits the absolute deadline. */
2792 w->deadline_sec = http_parked_write_deadline();
2793 continue;
2794 }
2795 if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
2796 if (n < 0 && (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) && http_parked_rearm(fd, w)) {
2797 /* Payload copied into the new slot; buf/state ownership moves with it. */
2798 return;
2799 }
2800 http_parked_write_finish(fd, w, false);
2801 return;
2802 }
2803 cwist_free(w->buf);
2804 w->buf = NULL;
2805
2806 if (w->mode == HTTP_PARK_FILE) {
2807#if defined(__linux__)
2808 http_parked_write_state_t *f = w->state;
2809 while (f && f->file_left > 0) {
2810 ssize_t n = sendfile(fd, f->file_fd, &f->file_off, f->file_left);
2811 if (n > 0) {
2812 f->file_left -= (size_t)n;
2813 w->deadline_sec = http_parked_write_deadline();
2814 continue;
2815 }
2816 if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
2817 if (n < 0 && (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) && http_parked_rearm(fd, w)) {
2818 return;
2819 }
2820 break;
2821 }
2822 http_parked_write_finish(fd, w, f && f->file_left == 0);
2823#else
2824 /* Non-Linux never parks FILE mode; defensive close. */
2825 http_parked_write_finish(fd, w, false);
2826#endif
2827 return;
2828 }
2829
2830 if (w->mode == HTTP_PARK_BODYREF) {
2831 http_parked_write_state_t *s = w->state;
2832 while (s && s->body_left > 0) {
2833 ssize_t n = send(fd, s->body + s->body_off, s->body_left, flags);
2834 if (n > 0) {
2835 s->body_off += (size_t)n;
2836 s->body_left -= (size_t)n;
2837 w->deadline_sec = http_parked_write_deadline();
2838 continue;
2839 }
2840 if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
2841 if (n < 0 && (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) && http_parked_rearm(fd, w)) {
2842 return;
2843 }
2844 break;
2845 }
2846 http_parked_write_finish(fd, w, s && s->body_left == 0);
2847 return;
2848 }
2849
2850 http_parked_write_finish(fd, w, true);
2851}
2852
2868static bool http_park_streamed_body(int client_fd, cwist_reactor_t *reactor,
2869 cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn, cwist_http_response *res,
2870 const char *header_buf, size_t header_len, size_t header_sent,
2871 const void *body_ptr, size_t body_len, bool keep_alive,
2872 bool file_mode) {
2873 http_parked_write_state_t *st = cwist_alloc(sizeof(*st));
2874 if (!st) return false;
2875 memset(st, 0, sizeof(*st));
2876 if (file_mode) {
2877#if defined(__linux__)
2878 st->file_fd = res->file_stream_fd;
2879 st->file_off = res->file_stream_offset;
2880 st->file_left = res->file_stream_len;
2881 if (res->file_stream_auto_close) {
2882 int dupfd = dup(res->file_stream_fd);
2883 if (dupfd < 0) {
2884 cwist_free(st);
2885 return false;
2886 }
2887 st->file_fd = dupfd;
2888 st->close_file_fd = true;
2889 }
2890#else
2891 cwist_free(st);
2892 return false;
2893#endif
2894 } else {
2895 size_t body_sent = header_sent > header_len ? header_sent - header_len : 0;
2896 st->body = (const char *)body_ptr;
2897 st->body_off = body_sent;
2898 st->body_left = body_len - body_sent;
2899 st->body_cleanup = res->ptr_body_cleanup;
2900 st->body_cleanup_ctx = res->ptr_body_cleanup_ctx;
2901 /* Ownership of the pointer body (and its cleanup hook) moves to the
2902 * park state; the caller's release becomes a no-op. */
2903 res->is_ptr_body = false;
2904 res->ptr_body = NULL;
2905 res->ptr_body_len = 0;
2906 res->ptr_body_cleanup = NULL;
2907 res->ptr_body_cleanup_ctx = NULL;
2908 }
2909
2910 http_parked_write_t w = {
2911 .reactor = reactor,
2912 .conn = conn,
2913 .buf = NULL,
2914 .off = 0,
2915 .len = 0,
2916 .state = st,
2917 .deadline_sec = http_parked_write_deadline(),
2918 .mode = file_mode ? HTTP_PARK_FILE : HTTP_PARK_BODYREF,
2919 .keep_alive = keep_alive,
2920 };
2921 size_t hd_left = header_sent < header_len ? header_len - header_sent : 0;
2922 if (hd_left > 0) {
2923 w.buf = cwist_alloc(hd_left);
2924 if (!w.buf) goto fail;
2925 memcpy(w.buf, header_buf + header_sent, hd_left);
2926 w.len = hd_left;
2927 }
2928 if (cwist_reactor_add_out(reactor, client_fd, http_parked_write_cb, &w, sizeof(w))) return true;
2929
2930fail:
2931 cwist_free(w.buf);
2932#if defined(__linux__)
2933 if (st->close_file_fd && st->file_fd >= 0) close(st->file_fd);
2934#endif
2935 if (!file_mode && st->body_cleanup && st->body) {
2936 /* Park failed after ownership moved: run the cleanup here so the
2937 * body is still released exactly once. */
2938 st->body_cleanup((void *)st->body, st->body_off + st->body_left, st->body_cleanup_ctx);
2939 res->is_ptr_body = false;
2940 res->ptr_body = NULL;
2941 res->ptr_body_len = 0;
2942 res->ptr_body_cleanup = NULL;
2943 res->ptr_body_cleanup_ctx = NULL;
2944 }
2945 cwist_free(st);
2946 return false;
2947}
2948
2949typedef enum {
2950 CWIST_FILE_BEGIN_FALLBACK = 0, /* nothing sent; caller may use the legacy path */
2951 CWIST_FILE_BEGIN_HANDLED, /* finished, parked, or closed; conn handled */
2952} cwist_file_begin_result_t;
2953
2967static cwist_file_begin_result_t cwist_http_file_begin(int client_fd, cwist_http_response *res,
2968 cwist_reactor_t *reactor,
2969 cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn,
2970 bool keep_alive, bool defer,
2971 cwist_async_send_status_t *status_out) {
2972#if !defined(__linux__)
2973 /* The non-blocking burst below relies on Linux sendfile(2) and dup(2).
2974 * Elsewhere (macOS/BSD sendfile has a different signature; Emscripten and
2975 * WASI have neither) nothing has been sent yet, so let the caller use the
2976 * bounded-blocking path, like http_park_streamed_body() does. */
2977 (void)client_fd;
2978 (void)res;
2979 (void)reactor;
2980 (void)conn;
2981 (void)keep_alive;
2982 (void)defer;
2983 (void)status_out;
2984 return CWIST_FILE_BEGIN_FALLBACK;
2985#else
2986 char header_buf[CWIST_HTTP_MAX_HEADER_SIZE];
2987 size_t header_len = serialize_headers(res, header_buf, sizeof(header_buf));
2988
2989 int flags = 0;
2990#if defined(MSG_NOSIGNAL)
2991 flags |= MSG_NOSIGNAL;
2992#endif
2993#if defined(MSG_DONTWAIT)
2994 flags |= MSG_DONTWAIT;
2995#endif
2996
2997 struct iovec iov = {.iov_base = header_buf, .iov_len = header_len};
2998 size_t sent = 0;
2999 cwist_write_status_t hst = cwist_http_sendmsg_speculative(client_fd, &iov, 1, flags, &sent);
3000
3001 if (hst == CWIST_WRITE_PENDING) {
3002 if (http_park_streamed_body(client_fd, reactor, conn, res, header_buf, header_len, sent,
3003 NULL, 0, keep_alive, true)) {
3004 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3005 if (defer && status_out) *status_out = CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_DEFERRED;
3006 return CWIST_FILE_BEGIN_HANDLED;
3007 }
3008 return CWIST_FILE_BEGIN_FALLBACK;
3009 }
3010
3011 /* Headers are on the wire (or failed fatally): from here the legacy path
3012 * would resend them, so this function owns the outcome. */
3013 http_parked_write_state_t *st = cwist_alloc(sizeof(*st));
3014 if (!st) {
3015 http_async_close(client_fd, conn);
3016 if (defer && status_out) *status_out = CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3017 return CWIST_FILE_BEGIN_HANDLED;
3018 }
3019 memset(st, 0, sizeof(*st));
3020 st->file_fd = res->file_stream_fd;
3021 st->file_off = res->file_stream_offset;
3022 st->file_left = res->file_stream_len;
3023 if (res->file_stream_auto_close) {
3024 int dupfd = dup(res->file_stream_fd);
3025 if (dupfd < 0) {
3026 cwist_free(st);
3027 http_async_close(client_fd, conn);
3028 if (defer && status_out) *status_out = CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3029 return CWIST_FILE_BEGIN_HANDLED;
3030 }
3031 st->file_fd = dupfd;
3032 st->close_file_fd = true;
3033 }
3034 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3035
3036 if (hst == CWIST_WRITE_ERR) {
3037 if (st->close_file_fd) close(st->file_fd);
3038 cwist_free(st);
3039 http_async_close(client_fd, conn);
3040 if (defer && status_out) *status_out = CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3041 return CWIST_FILE_BEGIN_HANDLED;
3042 }
3043
3044 while (st->file_left > 0) {
3045 ssize_t n = sendfile(client_fd, st->file_fd, &st->file_off, st->file_left);
3046 if (n > 0) {
3047 st->file_left -= (size_t)n;
3048 continue;
3049 }
3050 if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
3051 if (n < 0 && (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)) {
3052 http_parked_write_t w = {
3053 .reactor = reactor,
3054 .conn = conn,
3055 .buf = NULL,
3056 .off = 0,
3057 .len = 0,
3058 .state = st,
3059 .deadline_sec = http_parked_write_deadline(),
3060 .mode = HTTP_PARK_FILE,
3061 .keep_alive = keep_alive,
3062 };
3063 if (cwist_reactor_add_out(reactor, client_fd, http_parked_write_cb, &w, sizeof(w))) {
3064 if (defer && status_out) *status_out = CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_DEFERRED;
3065 return CWIST_FILE_BEGIN_HANDLED;
3066 }
3067 break;
3068 }
3069 break;
3070 }
3071
3072 bool drained = st->file_left == 0;
3073 if (st->close_file_fd) close(st->file_fd);
3074 cwist_free(st);
3075 if (drained && keep_alive && atomic_load(&g_cwist_running)) {
3076 if (defer && status_out) {
3077 *status_out = CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_KEEPALIVE;
3078 } else {
3079 cwist_http_async_rearm(client_fd, reactor, conn);
3080 }
3081 } else {
3082 if (defer && status_out) {
3083 *status_out = CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3084 } else {
3085 http_async_close(client_fd, conn);
3086 }
3087 }
3088 return CWIST_FILE_BEGIN_HANDLED;
3089#endif
3090}
3091
3101void cwist_http_async_send_response(int client_fd, cwist_http_response *res,
3102 cwist_reactor_t *reactor, cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn,
3103 bool keep_alive, bool head_only) {
3104 if (client_fd < 0 || !res || !reactor || !conn) {
3105 http_async_close(client_fd, conn);
3106 return;
3107 }
3108
3109 /* File streams: headers via the speculative path, body via non-blocking
3110 * sendfile; EAGAIN parks {fd, offset} state instead of blocking a
3111 * reactor thread in poll(). Falls back to the bounded-blocking path
3112 * only when nothing has been sent yet. */
3113 if (!head_only && res->use_file_stream) {
3114#if defined(__linux__)
3115 if (cwist_http_file_begin(client_fd, res, reactor, conn, keep_alive, false, NULL) ==
3116 CWIST_FILE_BEGIN_HANDLED) {
3117 return;
3118 }
3119#endif
3120 cwist_error_t err = cwist_http_send_response(client_fd, res);
3121 if (keep_alive && err.error.err_i16 == 0) {
3122 cwist_http_async_rearm(client_fd, reactor, conn);
3123 } else {
3124 http_async_close(client_fd, conn);
3125 }
3126 return;
3127 }
3128
3129 char header_buf[CWIST_HTTP_MAX_HEADER_SIZE];
3130 size_t header_len = serialize_headers(res, header_buf, sizeof(header_buf));
3131
3132 const void *body_ptr = NULL;
3133 size_t body_len = 0;
3134 if (!head_only) {
3135 if (res->is_ptr_body) {
3136 body_ptr = res->ptr_body;
3137 body_len = res->ptr_body_len;
3138 } else if (res->body && res->body->data) {
3139 body_ptr = res->body->data;
3140 body_len = res->body->size;
3141 }
3142 }
3143
3144 struct iovec iov[2];
3145 int iov_cnt = 1;
3146 iov[0].iov_base = header_buf;
3147 iov[0].iov_len = header_len;
3148 if (body_len > 0 && body_ptr) {
3149 iov[1].iov_base = (void *)body_ptr;
3150 iov[1].iov_len = body_len;
3151 iov_cnt = 2;
3152 }
3153
3154 int flags = 0;
3155#if defined(MSG_NOSIGNAL)
3156 flags |= MSG_NOSIGNAL;
3157#endif
3158#if defined(MSG_DONTWAIT)
3159 flags |= MSG_DONTWAIT;
3160#endif
3161
3162 size_t sent = 0;
3163 cwist_write_status_t st = cwist_http_sendmsg_speculative(client_fd, iov, iov_cnt, flags, &sent);
3164
3165 if (st == CWIST_WRITE_PENDING) {
3166 /* A pointer body parks by reference: ownership (and the cleanup
3167 * hook) moves to the park state instead of deep-copying the body. */
3168 if (res->is_ptr_body && body_ptr && body_len > 0 &&
3169 http_park_streamed_body(client_fd, reactor, conn, res, header_buf, header_len, sent,
3170 body_ptr, body_len, keep_alive, false)) {
3171 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res); /* no-op: ownership moved */
3172 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3173 return;
3174 }
3175 /* Deep-copy the unsent remainder before releasing the body: the
3176 * completion frees req/res (and the arena) right after we return. */
3177 size_t total = header_len + body_len;
3178 size_t left = total - sent;
3179 http_parked_write_t w = {
3180 .reactor = reactor,
3181 .conn = conn,
3182 .buf = cwist_alloc(left),
3183 .off = 0,
3184 .len = left,
3185 .deadline_sec = http_parked_write_deadline(),
3186 .keep_alive = keep_alive,
3187 };
3188 if (w.buf) {
3189 size_t hd_off = sent < header_len ? sent : header_len;
3190 size_t hd_left = header_len - hd_off;
3191 memcpy(w.buf, header_buf + hd_off, hd_left);
3192 if (left > hd_left) {
3193 size_t body_off = sent > header_len ? sent - header_len : 0;
3194 memcpy(w.buf + hd_left, (const char *)body_ptr + body_off, left - hd_left);
3195 }
3196 }
3197 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
3198 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3199 if (w.buf &&
3200 cwist_reactor_add_out(reactor, client_fd, http_parked_write_cb, &w, sizeof(w))) {
3201 return;
3202 }
3203 cwist_free(w.buf);
3204 http_async_close(client_fd, conn);
3205 return;
3206 }
3207
3208 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
3209 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3210 if (st == CWIST_WRITE_DONE && keep_alive && atomic_load(&g_cwist_running)) {
3211 cwist_http_async_rearm(client_fd, reactor, conn);
3212 } else {
3213 http_async_close(client_fd, conn);
3214 }
3215}
3216
3222cwist_async_send_status_t cwist_http_send_response_async(int client_fd, cwist_http_response *res,
3223 cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn,
3224 bool keep_alive, bool head_only) {
3225 if (client_fd < 0 || !res || !conn) return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3226
3227 if (!head_only && res->use_file_stream) {
3228#if defined(__linux__)
3229 cwist_async_send_status_t fstatus = CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3230 if (cwist_http_file_begin(client_fd, res, conn->reactor, conn, keep_alive, true,
3231 &fstatus) == CWIST_FILE_BEGIN_HANDLED) {
3232 return fstatus;
3233 }
3234#endif
3235 cwist_error_t err = cwist_http_send_response(client_fd, res);
3236 return (keep_alive && err.error.err_i16 == 0) ? CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_KEEPALIVE
3237 : CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3238 }
3239
3240 char header_buf[CWIST_HTTP_MAX_HEADER_SIZE];
3241 size_t header_len = serialize_headers(res, header_buf, sizeof(header_buf));
3242
3243 const void *body_ptr = NULL;
3244 size_t body_len = 0;
3245 if (!head_only) {
3246 if (res->is_ptr_body) {
3247 body_ptr = res->ptr_body;
3248 body_len = res->ptr_body_len;
3249 } else if (res->body && res->body->data) {
3250 body_ptr = res->body->data;
3251 body_len = res->body->size;
3252 }
3253 }
3254
3255 struct iovec iov[2];
3256 int iov_cnt = 1;
3257 iov[0].iov_base = header_buf;
3258 iov[0].iov_len = header_len;
3259 if (body_len > 0 && body_ptr) {
3260 iov[1].iov_base = (void *)body_ptr;
3261 iov[1].iov_len = body_len;
3262 iov_cnt = 2;
3263 }
3264
3265 int flags = 0;
3266#if defined(MSG_NOSIGNAL)
3267 flags |= MSG_NOSIGNAL;
3268#endif
3269#if defined(MSG_DONTWAIT)
3270 flags |= MSG_DONTWAIT;
3271#endif
3272
3273 size_t sent = 0;
3274 cwist_write_status_t st = cwist_http_sendmsg_speculative(client_fd, iov, iov_cnt, flags, &sent);
3275
3276 if (st == CWIST_WRITE_PENDING) {
3277 /* Pointer bodies park by reference (ownership moves to the park
3278 * state); everything else keeps the deep-copy remainder path. */
3279 if (res->is_ptr_body && body_ptr && body_len > 0 &&
3280 http_park_streamed_body(client_fd, conn->reactor, conn, res, header_buf, header_len,
3281 sent, body_ptr, body_len, keep_alive, false)) {
3282 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res); /* no-op: ownership moved */
3283 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3284 return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_DEFERRED;
3285 }
3286 size_t total = header_len + body_len;
3287 size_t left = total - sent;
3288 http_parked_write_t w = {
3289 .reactor = conn->reactor,
3290 .conn = conn,
3291 .buf = cwist_alloc(left),
3292 .off = 0,
3293 .len = left,
3294 .deadline_sec = http_parked_write_deadline(),
3295 .keep_alive = keep_alive,
3296 };
3297 if (w.buf) {
3298 size_t hd_off = sent < header_len ? sent : header_len;
3299 size_t hd_left = header_len - hd_off;
3300 memcpy(w.buf, header_buf + hd_off, hd_left);
3301 if (left > hd_left) {
3302 size_t body_off = sent > header_len ? sent - header_len : 0;
3303 memcpy(w.buf + hd_left, (const char *)body_ptr + body_off, left - hd_left);
3304 }
3305 if (cwist_reactor_add_out(conn->reactor, client_fd, http_parked_write_cb, &w,
3306 sizeof(w))) {
3307 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
3308 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3309 return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_DEFERRED;
3310 }
3311 cwist_free(w.buf);
3312 }
3313 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
3314 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3315 return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3316 }
3317
3318 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
3319 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3320 if (st == CWIST_WRITE_DONE) {
3321 return keep_alive ? CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_KEEPALIVE : CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3322 }
3323 return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3324}
3325
3326/* --- Response write coalescing (cleartext C1M async batch path) ------------
3327 * Responses served within one reactor batch turn append to conn->obuf and
3328 * flush with a single speculative write when the turn exits. A partial
3329 * flush deep-copies the remainder into the parked-write mechanism (the
3330 * batch loop must stop there; the parked drain re-arms the connection and
3331 * its continuation resumes the pipeline). Cap pressure, oversized bodies,
3332 * file streams, deferred completions, and 100 Continue drain the stash
3333 * through the bounded poll wait of cwist_http_sendmsg_all instead, keeping
3334 * byte order without unbounded buffering. */
3335
3341int cwist_http_coalesce_append(cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn, const void *data, size_t len) {
3342 if (len == 0) return 0;
3343 if (conn->olen + len > CWIST_HTTP_COALESCE_MAX) return -1;
3344 if (conn->olen + len > conn->ocap) {
3345 size_t ncap = conn->ocap ? conn->ocap : 16384;
3346 while (ncap < conn->olen + len) ncap *= 2;
3347 if (ncap > CWIST_HTTP_COALESCE_MAX) ncap = CWIST_HTTP_COALESCE_MAX;
3348 char *nb = cwist_alloc(ncap);
3349 if (!nb) return -1;
3350 if (conn->olen > 0) memcpy(nb, conn->obuf, conn->olen);
3351 cwist_free(conn->obuf);
3352 conn->obuf = nb;
3353 conn->ocap = ncap;
3354 }
3355 memcpy(conn->obuf + conn->olen, data, len);
3356 conn->olen += len;
3357 return 0;
3358}
3359
3367cwist_coalesce_flush_status_t
3368cwist_http_coalesce_flush(int client_fd, cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn, bool keep_alive) {
3369 if (!conn || conn->olen == 0) return CWIST_COALESCE_FLUSH_DONE;
3370
3371 struct iovec iov = {.iov_base = conn->obuf, .iov_len = conn->olen};
3372 int flags = 0;
3373#if defined(MSG_NOSIGNAL)
3374 flags |= MSG_NOSIGNAL;
3375#endif
3376#if defined(MSG_DONTWAIT)
3377 flags |= MSG_DONTWAIT;
3378#endif
3379
3380 size_t sent = 0;
3381 cwist_write_status_t st = cwist_http_sendmsg_speculative(client_fd, &iov, 1, flags, &sent);
3382 if (st == CWIST_WRITE_DONE) {
3383 conn->olen = 0;
3384 return CWIST_COALESCE_FLUSH_DONE;
3385 }
3386 if (st == CWIST_WRITE_PENDING) {
3387 size_t left = conn->olen - sent;
3388 http_parked_write_t w = {
3389 .reactor = conn->reactor,
3390 .conn = conn,
3391 .buf = cwist_alloc(left),
3392 .off = 0,
3393 .len = left,
3394 .deadline_sec = http_parked_write_deadline(),
3395 .keep_alive = keep_alive,
3396 };
3397 if (w.buf) {
3398 memcpy(w.buf, conn->obuf + sent, left);
3399 if (cwist_reactor_add_out(conn->reactor, client_fd, http_parked_write_cb, &w,
3400 sizeof(w))) {
3401 conn->olen = 0;
3402 return CWIST_COALESCE_FLUSH_PARKED;
3403 }
3404 cwist_free(w.buf);
3405 }
3406 }
3407 conn->olen = 0;
3408 return CWIST_COALESCE_FLUSH_ERROR;
3409}
3410
3415int cwist_http_coalesce_flush_blocking(int client_fd, cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn) {
3416 if (!conn || conn->olen == 0) return 0;
3417 struct iovec iov = {.iov_base = conn->obuf, .iov_len = conn->olen};
3418 int flags = 0;
3419#if defined(MSG_NOSIGNAL)
3420 flags |= MSG_NOSIGNAL;
3421#endif
3422#if defined(MSG_DONTWAIT)
3423 flags |= MSG_DONTWAIT;
3424#endif
3425 int rc = cwist_http_sendmsg_all(client_fd, &iov, 1, flags);
3426 conn->olen = 0;
3427 return rc;
3428}
3429
3434int cwist_http_coalesce_error_response(cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn, int status) {
3435 const char *reason = cwist_http_status_reason(status);
3436 if (!reason) reason = "Error";
3437
3438 char buf[512];
3439 int n = snprintf(
3440 buf, sizeof(buf),
3441 "HTTP/1.1 %d %s\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\nContent-Length: %zu\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n%s",
3442 status, reason, strlen(reason), reason);
3443 if (n <= 0) return -1;
3444 size_t len = (size_t)n < sizeof(buf) ? (size_t)n : sizeof(buf) - 1;
3445 return cwist_http_coalesce_append(conn, buf, len);
3446}
3447
3457cwist_async_send_status_t cwist_http_send_response_coalesced(int client_fd,
3458 cwist_http_response *res,
3459 cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn,
3460 bool keep_alive, bool head_only) {
3461 if (client_fd < 0 || !res || !conn) return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3462
3463 /* File streams: drain any buffered responses ahead of the file without
3464 * blocking the reactor (the obuf remainder parks as the file park's
3465 * prefix bytes), then stream the file through the non-blocking path;
3466 * EAGAIN parks {fd, offset} state. */
3467 if (!head_only && res->use_file_stream) {
3468#if defined(__linux__)
3469 int flags = 0;
3470#if defined(MSG_NOSIGNAL)
3471 flags |= MSG_NOSIGNAL;
3472#endif
3473#if defined(MSG_DONTWAIT)
3474 flags |= MSG_DONTWAIT;
3475#endif
3476 size_t sent = 0;
3477 cwist_write_status_t fst = CWIST_WRITE_DONE;
3478 if (conn->olen > 0) {
3479 struct iovec iov = {.iov_base = conn->obuf, .iov_len = conn->olen};
3480 fst = cwist_http_sendmsg_speculative(client_fd, &iov, 1, flags, &sent);
3481 }
3482 if (fst == CWIST_WRITE_PENDING) {
3483 /* The obuf remainder becomes the park's prefix; the file body
3484 * resumes behind it, preserving byte order. */
3485 if (http_park_streamed_body(client_fd, conn->reactor, conn, res, conn->obuf, conn->olen,
3486 sent, NULL, 0, keep_alive, true)) {
3487 conn->olen = 0;
3488 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3489 return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_DEFERRED;
3490 }
3491 conn->olen = 0;
3492 return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3493 }
3494 conn->olen = 0;
3495 if (fst == CWIST_WRITE_ERR) return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3496 cwist_async_send_status_t fstatus = CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3497 if (cwist_http_file_begin(client_fd, res, conn->reactor, conn, keep_alive, true,
3498 &fstatus) == CWIST_FILE_BEGIN_HANDLED) {
3499 return fstatus;
3500 }
3501#endif
3502 if (cwist_http_coalesce_flush_blocking(client_fd, conn) != 0) return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3503 cwist_error_t err = cwist_http_send_response(client_fd, res);
3504 return (keep_alive && err.error.err_i16 == 0) ? CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_KEEPALIVE
3505 : CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3506 }
3507
3508 const void *body_ptr = NULL;
3509 size_t body_len = 0;
3510 if (!head_only) {
3511 if (res->is_ptr_body) {
3512 body_ptr = res->ptr_body;
3513 body_len = res->ptr_body_len;
3514 } else if (res->body && res->body->data) {
3515 body_ptr = res->body->data;
3516 body_len = res->body->size;
3517 }
3518 }
3519
3520 /* Cap pressure is judged against the worst-case header size so the
3521 * header can be serialized directly into the coalesce buffer below,
3522 * skipping the stack-to-obuf copy on the common path. */
3523 size_t upper = CWIST_HTTP_MAX_HEADER_SIZE + body_len;
3524 if (upper > CWIST_HTTP_COALESCE_MAX || conn->olen + upper > CWIST_HTTP_COALESCE_MAX) {
3525 if (cwist_http_coalesce_flush_blocking(client_fd, conn) != 0) {
3526 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
3527 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3528 return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3529 }
3530 }
3531
3532 /* Oversized single response: serialize into a stack buffer and keep
3533 * the legacy speculative send with a parked remainder rather than
3534 * bouncing through the capped stash. */
3535 if (upper > CWIST_HTTP_COALESCE_MAX) {
3536 char header_buf[CWIST_HTTP_MAX_HEADER_SIZE];
3537 size_t header_len = serialize_headers(res, header_buf, sizeof(header_buf));
3538 size_t total = header_len + body_len;
3539 struct iovec iov[2];
3540 int iov_cnt = 1;
3541 iov[0].iov_base = header_buf;
3542 iov[0].iov_len = header_len;
3543 if (body_len > 0 && body_ptr) {
3544 iov[1].iov_base = (void *)body_ptr;
3545 iov[1].iov_len = body_len;
3546 iov_cnt = 2;
3547 }
3548
3549 int flags = 0;
3550#if defined(MSG_NOSIGNAL)
3551 flags |= MSG_NOSIGNAL;
3552#endif
3553#if defined(MSG_DONTWAIT)
3554 flags |= MSG_DONTWAIT;
3555#endif
3556
3557 size_t sent = 0;
3558 cwist_write_status_t st =
3559 cwist_http_sendmsg_speculative(client_fd, iov, iov_cnt, flags, &sent);
3560 if (st == CWIST_WRITE_PENDING) {
3561 /* Pointer bodies park by reference (ownership moves to the park
3562 * state); everything else keeps the deep-copy remainder path. */
3563 if (res->is_ptr_body && body_ptr && body_len > 0 &&
3564 http_park_streamed_body(client_fd, conn->reactor, conn, res, header_buf, header_len,
3565 sent, body_ptr, body_len, keep_alive, false)) {
3566 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res); /* no-op: ownership moved */
3567 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3568 return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_DEFERRED;
3569 }
3570 size_t left = total - sent;
3571 http_parked_write_t w = {
3572 .reactor = conn->reactor,
3573 .conn = conn,
3574 .buf = cwist_alloc(left),
3575 .off = 0,
3576 .len = left,
3577 .deadline_sec = http_parked_write_deadline(),
3578 .keep_alive = keep_alive,
3579 };
3580 if (w.buf) {
3581 size_t hd_off = sent < header_len ? sent : header_len;
3582 size_t hd_left = header_len - hd_off;
3583 memcpy(w.buf, header_buf + hd_off, hd_left);
3584 if (left > hd_left) {
3585 size_t body_off = sent > header_len ? sent - header_len : 0;
3586 memcpy(w.buf + hd_left, (const char *)body_ptr + body_off, left - hd_left);
3587 }
3588 if (cwist_reactor_add_out(conn->reactor, client_fd, http_parked_write_cb, &w,
3589 sizeof(w))) {
3590 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
3591 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3592 return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_DEFERRED;
3593 }
3594 cwist_free(w.buf);
3595 }
3596 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
3597 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3598 return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3599 }
3600
3601 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
3602 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3603 if (st == CWIST_WRITE_DONE) {
3604 return keep_alive ? CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_KEEPALIVE : CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3605 }
3606 return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3607 }
3608
3609 /* Common path: serialize the header straight into the stash buffer and
3610 * copy the body behind it. The cap check above guarantees
3611 * olen + MAX_HEADER_SIZE + body_len fits CWIST_HTTP_COALESCE_MAX, so the
3612 * single growth step below replaces the old serialize-to-stack then
3613 * memcpy-into-obuf sequence with one direct serialization. */
3614 if (conn->olen + upper > conn->ocap) {
3615 size_t ncap = conn->ocap ? conn->ocap : 16384;
3616 while (ncap < conn->olen + upper) ncap *= 2;
3617 char *nb = cwist_alloc(ncap);
3618 if (!nb) {
3619 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
3620 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3621 return CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3622 }
3623 if (conn->olen > 0) memcpy(nb, conn->obuf, conn->olen);
3624 cwist_free(conn->obuf);
3625 conn->obuf = nb;
3626 conn->ocap = ncap;
3627 }
3628 size_t header_len = serialize_headers(res, conn->obuf + conn->olen, CWIST_HTTP_MAX_HEADER_SIZE);
3629 conn->olen += header_len;
3630 if (body_len > 0 && body_ptr) {
3631 memcpy(conn->obuf + conn->olen, body_ptr, body_len);
3632 conn->olen += body_len;
3633 }
3634
3635 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
3636 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
3637 return keep_alive ? CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_KEEPALIVE : CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_CLOSE;
3638}

3719void cwist_http_send_error_response(int fd, int status, const char *msg) {
3720 if (fd < 0) return;
3721
3722 const char *reason = cwist_http_status_reason(status);
3723 if (!reason) reason = "Error";
3724 if (!msg) msg = reason;
3725
3726 /* The body goes out as its own iovec: formatting it into the fixed header
3727 * buffer truncated long messages while Content-Length still announced
3728 * strlen(msg), leaving the peer waiting for bytes that never came. */
3729 size_t msg_len = strlen(msg);
3730 char buf[256];
3731 int n = snprintf(
3732 buf, sizeof(buf),
3733 "HTTP/1.1 %d %s\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\nContent-Length: %zu\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
3734 status, reason, msg_len);
3735 if (n <= 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof(buf)) return;
3736
3737 struct iovec iov[2] = {
3738 {.iov_base = buf, .iov_len = (size_t)n},
3739 {.iov_base = (void *)msg, .iov_len = msg_len},
3740 };
3741 int flags = 0;
3742#if defined(MSG_NOSIGNAL)
3743 flags |= MSG_NOSIGNAL;
3744#endif
3745#if defined(MSG_DONTWAIT)
3746 flags |= MSG_DONTWAIT;
3747#endif
3748 (void)cwist_http_sendmsg_all(fd, iov, msg_len ? 2 : 1, flags);
3749}

3755static void http_send_100_continue(int fd) {
3756 static const char k_continue[] = "HTTP/1.1 100 Continue\r\n\r\n";
3757 struct iovec iov = {.iov_base = (void *)k_continue, .iov_len = sizeof(k_continue) - 1};
3758 int flags = 0;
3759#if defined(MSG_NOSIGNAL)
3760 flags |= MSG_NOSIGNAL;
3761#endif
3762 (void)cwist_http_sendmsg_all(fd, &iov, 1, flags);
3763}

3770cwist_sstring *cwist_http_stringify_response(cwist_http_response *res) {
3771 // Deprecated / Debug only
3772 if (!res) return NULL;
3773 cwist_sstring *s = cwist_sstring_create();
3774 if (!s) return NULL;
3775 char header_buf[CWIST_HTTP_MAX_HEADER_SIZE];
3776 /* serialize_headers returns a byte span, not a NUL-terminated string. */
3777 size_t header_len = serialize_headers(res, header_buf, sizeof(header_buf));
3778 cwist_sstring_assign_len(s, header_buf, header_len);
3779 if (res->is_ptr_body && res->ptr_body) {
3780 cwist_sstring_append_len(s, (char *)res->ptr_body, res->ptr_body_len);
3781 } else if (res->body) {
3782 cwist_sstring_append_len(s, res->body->data, res->body->size);
3783 }
3784 return s;
3785}

3799static int http_validate_transfer_encoding(cwist_http_header_node *headers) {
3800 bool seen = false;
3801 bool final_is_chunked = false;
3802 bool bad_coding = false;
3803 for (cwist_http_header_node *n = headers; n; n = n->next) {
3804 if (!n->key || !n->key->data || strcasecmp(n->key->data, "Transfer-Encoding") != 0)
3805 continue;
3806 const char *p = (n->value && n->value->data) ? n->value->data : "";
3807 bool any_token = false;
3808 bool last_chunked = false;
3809 while (*p) {
3810 while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t' || *p == ',') p++;
3811 const char *tok = p;
3812 while (*p && *p != ',') p++;
3813 const char *end = p;
3814 while (end > tok && (end[-1] == ' ' || end[-1] == '\t')) end--;
3815 if (*p) p++;
3816 if (end == tok) continue;
3817 any_token = true;
3818 /* A token with parameters (e.g. "chunked;x=1") is not chunked. */
3819 last_chunked = ((size_t)(end - tok) == 7 && strncasecmp(tok, "chunked", 7) == 0);
3820 if (!last_chunked) bad_coding = true;
3821 }
3822 if (!seen) {
3823 final_is_chunked = any_token && last_chunked;
3824 seen = true;
3825 }
3826 }
3827 if (!seen) return 0;
3828 if (!final_is_chunked) return 1;
3829 if (bad_coding) return 2;
3830 return 0;
3831}
3832
3838static cwist_http_request *
3839cwist_http_parse_request_with_header_end(const char *raw_request, size_t raw_len,
3840 const char *header_end,
3841 cwist_http_parse_error_t *err_out) {
3842 if (!raw_request || !header_end) return NULL;
3843
3844 const char *line_start = raw_request;
3845 const char *line_end = cwist_simd_find_crlf(line_start, (size_t)(header_end - line_start + 2));
3846 if (!line_end || line_end > header_end) {
3847 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_MALFORMED;
3848 return NULL;
3849 }
3850
3851 cwist_http_request *req = cwist_http_request_create();
3852 if (!req) {
3853 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_EOF;
3854 return NULL;
3855 }
3856
3857 // Fast path for root GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n
3858 if (line_start[0] == 'G' && line_start[1] == 'E' && line_start[2] == 'T' &&
3859 line_start[3] == ' ' && line_start[4] == '/' && line_start[5] == ' ' &&
3860 line_start[6] == 'H' && line_start[7] == 'T' && line_start[8] == 'T' &&
3861 line_start[9] == 'P' && line_start[10] == '/' && line_start[11] == '1' &&
3862 line_start[12] == '.' && line_start[13] == '1' && line_end == line_start + 14) {
3863 req->method = CWIST_HTTP_GET;
3864 cwist_sstring_borrow(req->path, "/", 1);
3865 cwist_sstring_borrow(req->query, "", 0);
3866 cwist_sstring_borrow(req->version, "HTTP/1.1", 8);
3867 req->keep_alive = true;
3868 } else {
3869 // 1. Request Line (Optimized: SIMD space search)
3870 const char *sp1 = cwist_simd_find_char(line_start, (size_t)(line_end - line_start), ' ');
3871 if (!sp1 || sp1 > line_end) {
3872 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
3873 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_MALFORMED;
3874 return NULL;
3875 }
3876 const char *sp2 = cwist_simd_find_char(sp1 + 1, (size_t)(line_end - (sp1 + 1)), ' ');
3877 if (!sp2 || sp2 > line_end) {
3878 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
3879 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_MALFORMED;
3880 return NULL;
3881 }
3882
3883 req->method = cwist_http_string_to_method_len(line_start, sp1 - line_start);
3884
3885 const char *path_start = sp1 + 1;
3886 const char *path_end = sp2;
3887 const char *query_sep =
3888 (const char *)memchr(path_start, '?', (size_t)(path_end - path_start));
3889
3890 if (query_sep) {
3891 cwist_http_sstring_assign_arena(req->path, (cwist_arena_t *)req->arena, path_start,
3892 (size_t)(query_sep - path_start));
3893 cwist_http_sstring_assign_arena(req->query, (cwist_arena_t *)req->arena, query_sep + 1,
3894 (size_t)(path_end - (query_sep + 1)));
3895 req->query_params = cwist_query_map_create_in_arena(req->arena);
3896 if (req->query_params) {
3897 cwist_query_map_parse(req->query_params, req->query->data);
3898 }
3899 } else {
3900 cwist_http_sstring_assign_arena(req->path, (cwist_arena_t *)req->arena, path_start,
3901 (size_t)(path_end - path_start));
3902 cwist_http_sstring_assign_arena(req->query, (cwist_arena_t *)req->arena, "", 0);
3903 }
3904
3905 cwist_http_sstring_assign_arena(req->version, (cwist_arena_t *)req->arena, sp2 + 1,
3906 (size_t)(line_end - (sp2 + 1)));
3907 if (strncmp(sp2 + 1, "HTTP/1.1", 8) == 0) {
3908 req->keep_alive = true;
3909 } else {
3910 req->keep_alive = false;
3911 }
3912 }
3913
3914 // 2. Headers (SIMD colon and CRLF scanning + SWAR)
3915 /* RFC 9110/9112 validation state tracked during the single header pass. */
3916 bool has_host = false, host_dup = false, host_empty = false;
3917 bool cl_seen = false, cl_bad = false;
3918 size_t cl_value = 0;
3919 bool te_seen = false;
3920 bool expect_100 = false, expect_bad = false;
3921 const bool is_http11 = req->version->data && strncmp(req->version->data, "HTTP/1.1", 8) == 0;
3922
3923 line_start = line_end + 2;
3924 while (line_start < header_end) {
3925 line_end = cwist_simd_find_crlf(line_start, (size_t)(header_end + 2 - line_start));
3926 if (!line_end || line_end == line_start) break;
3927
3928 const char *colon = cwist_simd_find_char(line_start, (size_t)(line_end - line_start), ':');
3929 if (colon) {
3930 size_t key_len = colon - line_start;
3931 const char *val_start = colon + 1;
3932 while (val_start < line_end && *val_start == ' ') val_start++;
3933 size_t val_len = line_end - val_start;
3934
3935 cwist_error_t herr =
3936 cwist_http_header_add_ex_len(&req->headers, (cwist_arena_t *)req->arena, line_start,
3937 key_len, val_start, val_len);
3938 bool header_ok = cwist_error_is_ok(&herr);
3939 cwist_error_dispose(&herr);
3940 if (!header_ok) {
3941 /* Out of memory: dropping the header could hide Host or
3942 * Content-Length from the checks below, so give up quietly as
3943 * cwist_http_request_create() failure does. */
3944 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
3945 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_EOF;
3946 return NULL;
3947 }
3948
3949 char k0 = line_start[0];
3950 if (key_len == 10 && (k0 == 'C' || k0 == 'c')) {
3951 uint64_t w0;
3952 memcpy(&w0, line_start, 8);
3953 if ((w0 | 0x2020202020202020ULL) == 0x697463656e6e6f63ULL) { /* "connecti" */
3954 uint16_t w1;
3955 memcpy(&w1, line_start + 8, 2);
3956 if ((w1 | 0x2020) == 0x6e6f) { /* "on" */
3957 if (val_len == 5 && (val_start[0] == 'c' || val_start[0] == 'C')) {
3958 if (strncasecmp(val_start, "close", 5) == 0) req->keep_alive = false;
3959 } else if (val_len == 10 && (val_start[0] == 'k' || val_start[0] == 'K')) {
3960 if (strncasecmp(val_start, "keep-alive", 10) == 0)
3961 req->keep_alive = true;
3962 }
3963 }
3964 }
3965 } else if (key_len == 14 && (k0 == 'C' || k0 == 'c')) {
3966 if (strncasecmp(line_start, "Content-Length", 14) == 0) {
3967 /* RFC 9112 section 6.3: strict digits-only parse; duplicate CL is
3968 * idempotent only when every value matches. */
3969 size_t vlen = val_len;
3970 while (vlen > 0 && (val_start[vlen - 1] == ' ' || val_start[vlen - 1] == '\t'))
3971 vlen--;
3972 if (vlen == 0) {
3973 cl_bad = true;
3974 } else {
3975 size_t len = 0;
3976 bool valid = true;
3977 for (size_t i = 0; i < vlen; i++) {
3978 if (val_start[i] >= '0' && val_start[i] <= '9') {
3979 if (len > (SIZE_MAX - 9) / 10) {
3980 valid = false;
3981 break;
3982 }
3983 len = len * 10 + (size_t)(val_start[i] - '0');
3984 } else {
3985 valid = false;
3986 break;
3987 }
3988 }
3989 if (!valid) {
3990 cl_bad = true;
3991 } else {
3992 if (cl_seen && cl_value != len) cl_bad = true;
3993 cl_seen = true;
3994 cl_value = len;
3995 req->content_length = len;
3996 }
3997 }
3998 }
3999 } else if (key_len == 4 && (k0 == 'H' || k0 == 'h')) {
4000 if (strncasecmp(line_start, "Host", 4) == 0) {
4001 if (has_host) host_dup = true;
4002 has_host = true;
4003 size_t vlen = val_len;
4004 while (vlen > 0 && (val_start[vlen - 1] == ' ' || val_start[vlen - 1] == '\t'))
4005 vlen--;
4006 if (vlen == 0) host_empty = true;
4007 }
4008 } else if (key_len == 17 && (k0 == 'T' || k0 == 't')) {
4009 if (strncasecmp(line_start, "Transfer-Encoding", 17) == 0) te_seen = true;
4010 } else if (key_len == 6 && (k0 == 'E' || k0 == 'e')) {
4011 if (strncasecmp(line_start, "Expect", 6) == 0) {
4012 /* RFC 9110 section 10.1.1: only the 100-continue expectation is
4013 * supported; record it here so the receive paths need no
4014 * second header walk. */
4015 size_t vlen = val_len;
4016 while (vlen > 0 && (val_start[vlen - 1] == ' ' || val_start[vlen - 1] == '\t'))
4017 vlen--;
4018 if (vlen == 12 && strncasecmp(val_start, "100-continue", 12) == 0) {
4019 expect_100 = true;
4020 } else {
4021 expect_bad = true;
4022 }
4023 }
4024 }
4025 }
4026 line_start = line_end + 2;
4027 }
4028
4029 /* RFC 9112 section 3.2: HTTP/1.1 requests must carry exactly one non-empty Host. */
4030 if (is_http11 && (!has_host || host_dup || host_empty)) {
4031 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4032 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_MALFORMED;
4033 return NULL;
4034 }
4035 if (cl_bad) {
4036 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4037 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_MALFORMED;
4038 return NULL;
4039 }
4040 if (te_seen) {
4041 /* RFC 9112 section 6.3: TE and CL together are a request-smuggling vector. */
4042 if (cl_seen) {
4043 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4044 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_MALFORMED;
4045 return NULL;
4046 }
4047 int tev = http_validate_transfer_encoding(req->headers);
4048 if (tev != 0) {
4049 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4050 if (err_out)
4051 *err_out =
4052 (tev == 1) ? CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_MALFORMED : CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_TE_UNSUPPORTED;
4053 return NULL;
4054 }
4055 }
4056 /* RFC 9110 section 10.1.1: only the 100-continue expectation is supported. */
4057 if (expect_bad) {
4058 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4059 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_EXPECT_FAILED;
4060 return NULL;
4061 }
4062 req->te_chunked_seen = te_seen;
4063 req->expect_100_seen = expect_100;
4064
4065 const char *body_start = header_end + 4;
4066 size_t available = raw_len - (size_t)(body_start - raw_request);
4067 if (available > 0) {
4068 size_t to_take = (req->content_length > 0 && req->content_length < available)
4069 ? req->content_length
4070 : available;
4071 cwist_http_sstring_assign_arena(req->body, (cwist_arena_t *)req->arena, body_start,
4072 to_take);
4073 }
4074
4075 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_OK;
4076 return req;
4077}
4078
4083cwist_http_request *cwist_http_parse_request(const char *raw_request) {
4084 if (!raw_request) return NULL;
4085 size_t raw_len = strlen(raw_request);
4086 const char *header_end = cwist_simd_find_crlfcrlf(raw_request, raw_len);
4087 if (!header_end) return NULL;
4088 return cwist_http_parse_request_with_header_end(raw_request, raw_len, header_end, NULL);
4089}
4090
4095cwist_http_request *cwist_http_parse_request_len(const char *buf, size_t len) {
4096 if (!buf || len == 0) return NULL;
4097 const char *header_end = cwist_simd_find_crlfcrlf(buf, len);
4098 if (!header_end) return NULL;
4099 return cwist_http_parse_request_with_header_end(buf, len, header_end, NULL);
4100}
4101
4110int cwist_http_response_serialize(cwist_http_response *res, char **out, size_t *out_len) {
4111 if (!res || !out || !out_len) return -1;
4112 if (res->use_file_stream) return -1; /* streaming bodies need a socket */
4113
4114 char header_buf[CWIST_HTTP_MAX_HEADER_SIZE];
4115 size_t header_len = serialize_headers(res, header_buf, sizeof(header_buf));
4116
4117 const void *body = NULL;
4118 size_t body_len = 0;
4119 if (res->stream_mode) {
4120 /* Chunked framing was appended at write time; auto-finalize so the
4121 * terminator is present even when the handler skipped end(). */
4122 if (!res->stream_ended) cwist_http_response_stream_end(res);
4123 body = res->stream_buf ? res->stream_buf->data : NULL;
4124 body_len = res->stream_buf ? res->stream_buf->size : 0;
4125 } else if (res->is_ptr_body) {
4126 body = res->ptr_body;
4127 body_len = res->ptr_body_len;
4128 } else if (res->body && res->body->data) {
4129 body = res->body->data;
4130 body_len = res->body->size;
4131 }
4132
4133 char *buf = (char *)cwist_alloc(header_len + body_len + 1);
4134 if (!buf) return -1;
4135 memcpy(buf, header_buf, header_len);
4136 if (body_len) memcpy(buf + header_len, body, body_len);
4137 buf[header_len + body_len] = '\0';
4138 *out = buf;
4139 *out_len = header_len + body_len;
4140 return 0;
4141}
4142
4143/* --- Streaming producer (issue #201 Phase 1) ------------------------------ */
4144
4148static int cwist_response_stream_flush(cwist_http_response *res) {
4149 if (!res->stream_sink) return 0;
4150 if (!res->stream_head_sent) {
4151 char head_buf[CWIST_HTTP_MAX_HEADER_SIZE];
4152 size_t head_len = serialize_headers(res, head_buf, sizeof(head_buf));
4153 if (head_len == 0 || head_len >= sizeof(head_buf)) return -1;
4154 if (res->stream_sink(res->stream_sink_ctx, head_buf, head_len) != 0) return -1;
4155 res->stream_head_sent = true;
4156 }
4157 size_t pending = res->stream_buf ? res->stream_buf->size - res->stream_flushed : 0;
4158 if (pending > 0) {
4159 if (res->stream_sink(res->stream_sink_ctx, res->stream_buf->data + res->stream_flushed,
4160 pending) != 0)
4161 return -1;
4162 res->stream_flushed = res->stream_buf->size;
4163 }
4164 return 0;
4165}
4166
4174int cwist_http_response_stream_begin(cwist_http_response *res) {
4175 if (!res || res->stream_mode || res->is_ptr_body || res->use_file_stream) return -1;
4176 res->stream_mode = true;
4177 /* A body assigned before begin is discarded: chunked framing owns the
4178 * payload from here on. */
4179 if (res->body) res->body->size = 0; /* discard any body assigned before begin */
4180 return 0;
4181}
4182
4190int cwist_http_response_stream_write(cwist_http_response *res, const char *data, size_t len) {
4191 if (!res || !res->stream_mode || res->stream_ended) return -1;
4192 if (!data) return -1;
4193 if (len == 0) return 0; /* an empty chunk is the terminator; never emit one mid-stream */
4194 if (!res->stream_buf) {
4195 res->stream_buf = cwist_http_sstring_create(res->arena);
4196 if (!res->stream_buf) return -1;
4197 }
4198 char frame_hdr[24];
4199 int frame_hdr_len = snprintf(frame_hdr, sizeof(frame_hdr), "%zx\r\n", len);
4200 if (frame_hdr_len <= 0) return -1;
4201 cwist_error_t append_err =
4202 cwist_sstring_append_len(res->stream_buf, frame_hdr, (size_t)frame_hdr_len);
4203 if (cwist_error_is_ok(&append_err))
4204 append_err = cwist_sstring_append_len(res->stream_buf, data, len);
4205 if (cwist_error_is_ok(&append_err))
4206 append_err = cwist_sstring_append_len(res->stream_buf, "\r\n", 2);
4207 if (!cwist_error_is_ok(&append_err)) return -1;
4208 if (cwist_response_stream_flush(res) != 0) {
4209 res->stream_failed = true;
4210 return -1;
4211 }
4212 return 0;
4213}
4214
4220int cwist_http_response_stream_end(cwist_http_response *res) {
4221 if (!res || !res->stream_mode || res->stream_ended) return -1;
4222 if (!res->stream_buf) {
4223 res->stream_buf = cwist_http_sstring_create(res->arena);
4224 if (!res->stream_buf) return -1;
4225 }
4226 cwist_error_t end_err = cwist_sstring_append_len(res->stream_buf, "0\r\n\r\n", 5);
4227 if (!cwist_error_is_ok(&end_err)) return -1;
4228 if (cwist_response_stream_flush(res) != 0) {
4229 res->stream_failed = true;
4230 return -1;
4231 }
4232 res->stream_ended = true;
4233 return 0;
4234}
4235
4240static int http_parse_chunk_size(const char *line, size_t len, size_t *out_size) {
4241 size_t value = 0, digits = 0;
4242 for (size_t i = 0; i < len && line[i] != ';'; ++i) {
4243 unsigned char c = (unsigned char)line[i];
4244 unsigned int digit;
4245 if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
4246 digit = c - '0';
4247 else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f')
4248 digit = c - 'a' + 10;
4249 else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F')
4250 digit = c - 'A' + 10;
4251 else
4252 return -1;
4253 if (value > (CWIST_HTTP_MAX_BODY_SIZE - digit) / 16) return -1;
4254 value = value * 16 + digit;
4255 ++digits;
4256 }
4257 if (!digits) return -1;
4258 *out_size = value;
4259 return 0;
4260}
4261
4269static bool http_chunk_append(cwist_sstring *out, const char *data, size_t len) {
4270 cwist_error_t err = cwist_sstring_append_len(out, data, len);
4271 bool ok = cwist_error_is_ok(&err);
4272 cwist_error_dispose(&err);
4273 return ok;
4274}
4275
4283static int http_read_chunked_body(int client_fd, char *buf, size_t *avail, size_t buf_cap,
4284 cwist_sstring *out) {
4285 size_t offset = 0;
4286
4287 while (1) {
4288 char *crlf = memmem(buf + offset, *avail - offset, "\r\n", 2);
4289 while (!crlf) {
4290 if (*avail >= buf_cap - 1) return -1;
4291 ssize_t bytes = recv(client_fd, buf + *avail, buf_cap - 1 - *avail, 0);
4292 if (bytes < 0) {
4293 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
4294 struct pollfd pfd = {.fd = client_fd, .events = POLLIN};
4295 int ret = poll(&pfd, 1, CWIST_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS);
4296 if (ret <= 0) return -1;
4297 continue;
4298 }
4299 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
4300 return -1;
4301 }
4302 if (bytes == 0) return -1;
4303 *avail += (size_t)bytes;
4304 buf[*avail] = '\0';
4305 crlf = memmem(buf + offset, *avail - offset, "\r\n", 2);
4306 }
4307
4308 size_t line_len = (size_t)(crlf - (buf + offset)) + 2;
4309 size_t chunk_size = 0;
4310 /* Strict hexadecimal parsing prevents accepting contaminated framing
4311 * such as `4junk` or signed/overflowed chunk lengths. */
4312 if (http_parse_chunk_size(buf + offset, line_len - 2, &chunk_size) != 0) return -1;
4313 offset += line_len;
4314
4315 if (chunk_size == 0) {
4316 /* Consume optional trailers until empty line */
4317 while (offset + 1 < *avail && !(buf[offset] == '\r' && buf[offset + 1] == '\n')) {
4318 char *trailer_crlf = memmem(buf + offset, *avail - offset, "\r\n", 2);
4319 if (!trailer_crlf) {
4320 if (*avail >= buf_cap - 1) return -1;
4321 ssize_t bytes = recv(client_fd, buf + *avail, buf_cap - 1 - *avail, 0);
4322 if (bytes < 0) {
4323 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
4324 struct pollfd pfd = {.fd = client_fd, .events = POLLIN};
4325 int ret = poll(&pfd, 1, CWIST_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS);
4326 if (ret <= 0) return -1;
4327 continue;
4328 }
4329 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
4330 return -1;
4331 }
4332 if (bytes == 0) return -1;
4333 *avail += (size_t)bytes;
4334 buf[*avail] = '\0';
4335 trailer_crlf = memmem(buf + offset, *avail - offset, "\r\n", 2);
4336 }
4337 if (trailer_crlf) {
4338 offset = (size_t)(trailer_crlf - buf) + 2;
4339 }
4340 }
4341 if (offset + 1 < *avail && buf[offset] == '\r' && buf[offset + 1] == '\n') {
4342 offset += 2;
4343 }
4344 break;
4345 }
4346
4347 if (chunk_size > CWIST_HTTP_MAX_BODY_SIZE ||
4348 out->size + chunk_size > CWIST_HTTP_MAX_BODY_SIZE)
4349 return -1;
4350
4351 while (*avail - offset < chunk_size + 2) {
4352 if (*avail >= buf_cap - 1) return -1;
4353 ssize_t bytes = recv(client_fd, buf + *avail, buf_cap - 1 - *avail, 0);
4354 if (bytes < 0) {
4355 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
4356 struct pollfd pfd = {.fd = client_fd, .events = POLLIN};
4357 int ret = poll(&pfd, 1, CWIST_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS);
4358 if (ret <= 0) return -1;
4359 continue;
4360 }
4361 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
4362 return -1;
4363 }
4364 if (bytes == 0) return -1;
4365 *avail += (size_t)bytes;
4366 buf[*avail] = '\0';
4367 }
4368
4369 if (buf[offset + chunk_size] != '\r' || buf[offset + chunk_size + 1] != '\n') return -1;
4370 if (!http_chunk_append(out, buf + offset, chunk_size)) return -1;
4371 offset += chunk_size + 2;
4372 }
4373
4374 size_t leftover = *avail - offset;
4375 if (leftover > 0) {
4376 memmove(buf, buf + offset, leftover);
4377 }
4378 *avail = leftover;
4379 return 0;
4380}
4381
4392cwist_http_request *cwist_http_receive_request(int client_fd, char *read_buf, size_t buf_size,
4393 size_t *buf_len, cwist_http_parse_error_t *err_out) {
4394 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_EOF;
4395 size_t total_received = *buf_len;
4396 char *header_end = NULL;
4397
4398 // 1. Read until headers are complete. The classic pool serves this
4399 // socket blocking, so a client dribbling the header byte-by-byte would
4400 // hold the thread forever; bound the whole header read by
4401 // CWIST_HTTP_HEADERS_TIMEOUT_MS (same budget the TLS path enforces).
4402 struct timespec header_start;
4403 clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &header_start);
4404 while (!(header_end = (char *)cwist_simd_find_crlfcrlf(read_buf, total_received))) {
4405 if (total_received >= buf_size - 1) {
4406 /* Fat Cookie/Authorization combinations can legitimately push a
4407 * header block past the read buffer; without this trail the drop
4408 * is indistinguishable from a client vanish. */
4409 cwist_metric_inc(cwist_metrics_registry(), CWIST_METRIC_HTTP_HEADER_OVERFLOW);
4410 CWIST_LOG_WARN("[http] dropping connection: headers exceed %zu-byte read buffer",
4411 buf_size);
4412 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_HEADER_OVERFLOW;
4413 return NULL;
4414 }
4415
4416 struct timespec now;
4417 clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);
4418 long elapsed_ms = (now.tv_sec - header_start.tv_sec) * 1000L +
4419 (now.tv_nsec - header_start.tv_nsec) / 1000000L;
4420 long remaining_ms = (long)CWIST_HTTP_HEADERS_TIMEOUT_MS - elapsed_ms;
4421 if (remaining_ms <= 0) {
4422 CWIST_LOG_WARN("[http] dropping connection: header read exceeded %d ms",
4423 CWIST_HTTP_HEADERS_TIMEOUT_MS);
4424 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_EOF;
4425 return NULL;
4426 }
4427 struct pollfd pfd = {.fd = client_fd, .events = POLLIN};
4428 int pr = poll(&pfd, 1, (int)(remaining_ms > 1000 ? 1000 : remaining_ms));
4429 if (pr <= 0) {
4430 if (pr < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
4431 if (pr < 0) continue; /* transient errors retry within the budget */
4432 continue; /* timeout slice expired; re-check the budget */
4433 }
4434
4435 ssize_t bytes =
4436 recv(client_fd, read_buf + total_received, buf_size - 1 - total_received, 0);
4437 if (bytes <= 0) {
4438 if (bytes < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
4439 if (bytes < 0 && (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK)) continue;
4440 return NULL;
4441 }
4442 total_received += (size_t)bytes;
4443 read_buf[total_received] = '\0';
4444 }
4445
4446 cwist_http_request *req =
4447 cwist_http_parse_request_with_header_end(read_buf, total_received, header_end, err_out);
4448 if (!req) return NULL;
4449
4450 size_t header_len = (size_t)(header_end + 4 - read_buf);
4451 size_t body_received = total_received - header_len;
4452
4453 /* RFC 9110 section 10.1.1: the parser already validated that any Expect value is
4454 * exactly "100-continue"; answer it before waiting on the body. Flags were
4455 * recorded during the header pass — no second walk needed. */
4456 const bool te = req->te_chunked_seen;
4457 const bool expect = req->expect_100_seen;
4458 if (expect &&
4459 ((size_t)req->content_length > body_received || (te && req->content_length == 0))) {
4460 http_send_100_continue(client_fd);
4461 }
4462
4463 // 2. Read body based on Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding
4464 if (req->content_length > 0) {
4465 if (req->content_length > CWIST_HTTP_MAX_BODY_SIZE) {
4466 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4467 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_BODY_TOO_LARGE;
4468 return NULL;
4469 }
4470
4471 // Allocate body
4472 char *body = cwist_alloc(req->content_length + 1);
4473 if (!body) {
4474 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4475 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_EOF;
4476 return NULL;
4477 }
4478
4479 size_t to_copy = (body_received < (size_t)req->content_length)
4480 ? body_received
4481 : (size_t)req->content_length;
4482 memcpy(body, header_end + 4, to_copy);
4483 size_t current_body_len = to_copy;
4484
4485 while (current_body_len < (size_t)req->content_length) {
4486 ssize_t bytes = recv(client_fd, body + current_body_len,
4487 (size_t)req->content_length - current_body_len, 0);
4488 if (bytes < 0) {
4489 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
4490 struct pollfd pfd = {.fd = client_fd, .events = POLLIN};
4491 int ret = poll(&pfd, 1, CWIST_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS);
4492 if (ret <= 0) {
4493 cwist_free(body);
4494 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4495 return NULL;
4496 }
4497 continue;
4498 }
4499 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
4500 cwist_free(body);
4501 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4502 return NULL;
4503 }
4504 if (bytes == 0) {
4505 cwist_free(body);
4506 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4507 return NULL;
4508 }
4509 current_body_len += (size_t)bytes;
4510 }
4511 body[req->content_length] = '\0';
4512 /* Adopt the filled buffer: one allocation, zero copies. The partial
4513 * body the parser staged in the arena is simply superseded. */
4514 cwist_sstring_adopt_len(req->body, body, (size_t)req->content_length);
4515
4516 // Calculate leftovers
4517 if (body_received > (size_t)req->content_length) {
4518 size_t leftover_len = body_received - (size_t)req->content_length;
4519 memmove(read_buf, header_end + 4 + req->content_length, leftover_len);
4520 *buf_len = leftover_len;
4521 } else {
4522 *buf_len = 0;
4523 }
4524 } else {
4525 /* A surviving Transfer-Encoding header was validated by the parser as
4526 * chunked-only with chunked final, so presence alone selects framing. */
4527 if (te) {
4528 if (body_received > 0) {
4529 memmove(read_buf, header_end + 4, body_received);
4530 }
4531 *buf_len = body_received;
4532 read_buf[*buf_len] = '\0';
4533
4534 cwist_sstring *chunked = cwist_sstring_create();
4535 if (!chunked) {
4536 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4537 return NULL;
4538 }
4539 if (http_read_chunked_body(client_fd, read_buf, buf_len, buf_size, chunked) != 0) {
4540 cwist_sstring_destroy(chunked);
4541 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4542 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_MALFORMED;
4543 return NULL;
4544 }
4545 /* Move the assembled buffer into the request body instead of
4546 * copying it a second time. */
4547 char *chunked_data = chunked->data;
4548 size_t chunked_len = chunked->size;
4549 chunked->data = NULL;
4550 chunked->size = 0;
4551 cwist_sstring_destroy(chunked);
4552 cwist_sstring_adopt_len(req->body, chunked_data, chunked_len);
4553 } else {
4554 // No body, leftovers are everything after headers
4555 if (body_received > 0) {
4556 memmove(read_buf, header_end + 4, body_received);
4557 *buf_len = body_received;
4558 } else {
4559 *buf_len = 0;
4560 }
4561 }
4562 }
4563 read_buf[*buf_len] = '\0';
4564
4565 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_OK;
4566 return req;
4567}
4568
4569/* --- Non-blocking request assembly for the async (C1M) path --------------- */
4570
4571#define CWIST_ASYNC_STASH_MAX (CWIST_HTTP_READ_BUFFER_SIZE + CWIST_HTTP_MAX_BODY_SIZE)
4572
4573/* Bodies at least this large transfer stash-buffer ownership to the request
4574 * (zero-copy region view) instead of being copied out. Below the threshold
4575 * the copy is cheaper than allocating the connection a fresh stash. */
4576#define CWIST_HTTP_BODY_ZC_MIN (16 * 1024)
4577
4579static bool http_async_stash_grow(cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn, size_t need) {
4580 /* RX-uring invariant: the stash buffer must not move while a RECV SQE
4581 * references it. Growth only happens while serving (in-flight RECV
4582 * cleared), so this is defensive: fail closed rather than relocate the
4583 * buffer under the kernel's DMA. */
4584 if (conn->rx_recv_inflight) return false;
4585 if (need > CWIST_ASYNC_STASH_MAX) return false;
4586 if (conn->cap >= need) return true;
4587 size_t cap = conn->cap ? conn->cap : CWIST_HTTP_READ_BUFFER_SIZE;
4588 while (cap < need) {
4589 if (cap > CWIST_ASYNC_STASH_MAX / 2) {
4590 cap = CWIST_ASYNC_STASH_MAX;
4591 break;
4592 }
4593 cap *= 2;
4594 }
4595 if (cap > CWIST_ASYNC_STASH_MAX) cap = CWIST_ASYNC_STASH_MAX;
4596 if (cap == conn->cap) return false;
4597 char *nb = cwist_realloc(conn->rbuf, cap);
4598 if (!nb) return false;
4599 conn->rbuf = nb;
4600 conn->cap = cap;
4601 return true;
4602}
4603
4612int cwist_http_async_conn_fill(cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn) {
4613 if (conn->peer_eof) return 0;
4614 if (conn->rx_recv_inflight || conn->rx_data_ready) {
4615 /* RX-uring path: the in-flight RECV SQE owns the socket read (never
4616 * recv() on top of it), and a completed RECV already staged its bytes
4617 * (or recorded EOF) into the stash. Nothing to drain here. */
4618 conn->rx_data_ready = false;
4619 return 0;
4620 }
4621 for (;;) {
4622 if (conn->len + 1 >= conn->cap && !http_async_stash_grow(conn, conn->len + 4096)) {
4623 return -1;
4624 }
4625 size_t avail = conn->cap - 1 - conn->len;
4626 ssize_t n = recv(conn->fd, conn->rbuf + conn->len, avail, 0);
4627 if (n > 0) {
4628 conn->len += (size_t)n;
4629 conn->rbuf[conn->len] = '\0';
4630 conn->virgin = false;
4631 if ((size_t)n < avail) return 0; /* short read: drained for now */
4632 continue;
4633 }
4634 if (n == 0) {
4635 /* A half-close does not discard already buffered requests. */
4636 conn->peer_eof = true;
4637 return 0;
4638 }
4639 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
4640 if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) return 0;
4641 return -1;
4642 }
4643}
4644
4650static int http_chunked_scan(const char *buf, size_t avail, size_t *consumed,
4651 cwist_sstring *assemble) {
4652 size_t pos = 0;
4653 for (;;) {
4654 char *crlf = memmem(buf + pos, avail - pos, "\r\n", 2);
4655 if (!crlf) return avail > CWIST_ASYNC_STASH_MAX ? -1 : 0;
4656 size_t line_len = (size_t)(crlf - (buf + pos));
4657 size_t chunk_size = 0;
4658 if (http_parse_chunk_size(buf + pos, line_len, &chunk_size) != 0) return -1;
4659 pos += line_len + 2;
4660
4661 if (chunk_size == 0) {
4662 /* Trailers until an empty line. */
4663 for (;;) {
4664 if (avail - pos < 2) return 0;
4665 if (buf[pos] == '\r' && buf[pos + 1] == '\n') {
4666 *consumed = pos + 2;
4667 return 1;
4668 }
4669 char *tcrlf = memmem(buf + pos, avail - pos, "\r\n", 2);
4670 if (!tcrlf) return 0;
4671 pos = (size_t)(tcrlf - buf) + 2;
4672 }
4673 }
4674
4675 if (chunk_size > CWIST_HTTP_MAX_BODY_SIZE) return -1;
4676 if (avail - pos < chunk_size + 2) return 0;
4677 if (buf[pos + chunk_size] != '\r' || buf[pos + chunk_size + 1] != '\n') return -1;
4678 if (assemble) {
4679 if (assemble->size + chunk_size > CWIST_HTTP_MAX_BODY_SIZE) return -1;
4680 if (!http_chunk_append(assemble, (const char *)buf + pos, chunk_size)) return -1;
4681 }
4682 pos += chunk_size + 2;
4683 }
4684}
4685
4691cwist_recv_status_t cwist_http_receive_request_nb(cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn,
4692 cwist_http_request **out,
4693 cwist_http_parse_error_t *err_out) {
4694 *out = NULL;
4695 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_OK;
4696 if (!conn->rbuf || conn->len == 0) return CWIST_RECV_NEED_MORE;
4697
4698 char *header_end = (char *)cwist_simd_find_crlfcrlf(conn->rbuf, conn->len);
4699 if (!header_end) {
4700 if (conn->len >= CWIST_HTTP_READ_BUFFER_SIZE - 1) {
4701 cwist_metric_inc(cwist_metrics_registry(), CWIST_METRIC_HTTP_HEADER_OVERFLOW);
4702 CWIST_LOG_WARN("[http] dropping async connection: headers exceed %d-byte read buffer",
4703 CWIST_HTTP_READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
4704 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_HEADER_OVERFLOW;
4705 return CWIST_RECV_FATAL;
4706 }
4707 return CWIST_RECV_NEED_MORE;
4708 }
4709
4710 /* Framing below assembles this request's body. Passing the whole stash
4711 * here copies later pipelined messages into body-less requests too. */
4712 size_t header_len = (size_t)(header_end + 4 - conn->rbuf);
4713 cwist_http_request *req =
4714 cwist_http_parse_request_with_header_end(conn->rbuf, header_len, header_end, err_out);
4715 if (!req) return CWIST_RECV_FATAL;
4716
4717 size_t body_received = conn->len - header_len;
4718 size_t consumed = header_len;
4719
4720 /* RFC 9110 section 10.1.1: answer a validated Expect: 100-continue once, before
4721 * the stash accumulates the full body. Flags come from the header pass. */
4722 const bool te = req->te_chunked_seen;
4723 const bool expect = req->expect_100_seen;
4724 if (expect && !conn->expect_continue_sent &&
4725 ((size_t)req->content_length > body_received || (te && req->content_length == 0))) {
4726 /* Buffered coalesced responses must drain first: the client holds
4727 * the body until this interim reply arrives. */
4728 cwist_http_coalesce_flush_blocking(conn->fd, conn);
4729 http_send_100_continue(conn->fd);
4730 conn->expect_continue_sent = true;
4731 }
4732
4733 if (req->content_length > 0) {
4734 if (req->content_length > CWIST_HTTP_MAX_BODY_SIZE) {
4735 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4736 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_BODY_TOO_LARGE;
4737 return CWIST_RECV_FATAL;
4738 }
4739 if (body_received < (size_t)req->content_length) {
4740 /* Not all here yet; make sure the stash can hold the full message. */
4741 if (!http_async_stash_grow(conn, header_len + (size_t)req->content_length + 1)) {
4742 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4743 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_EOF;
4744 return CWIST_RECV_FATAL;
4745 }
4746 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4747 return CWIST_RECV_NEED_MORE;
4748 }
4749 /* Zero-copy handover: a large body ending exactly at the stash end
4750 * moves buffer ownership to the request as a region view over the
4751 * payload, and the connection starts on a fresh stash. Both fill
4752 * paths keep rbuf[len] NUL-terminated, which is the adopted region's
4753 * terminating slot. Pipelined leftovers and small bodies keep the
4754 * copy path below. */
4755 if (header_len + (size_t)req->content_length == conn->len &&
4756 (size_t)req->content_length >= CWIST_HTTP_BODY_ZC_MIN) {
4757 char *fresh = cwist_alloc(CWIST_HTTP_READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
4758 if (fresh) {
4759 fresh[0] = '\0';
4760 conn->rbuf[conn->len] = '\0'; /* defensive: region NUL slot */
4761 cwist_sstring_adopt_region(req->body, conn->rbuf, header_len,
4762 (size_t)req->content_length);
4763 conn->rbuf = fresh;
4764 conn->cap = CWIST_HTTP_READ_BUFFER_SIZE;
4765 conn->len = 0;
4766 consumed = 0; /* nothing left to shift */
4767 }
4768 }
4769 if (consumed > 0) {
4770 char *body = cwist_alloc((size_t)req->content_length + 1);
4771 if (!body) {
4772 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4773 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_EOF;
4774 return CWIST_RECV_FATAL;
4775 }
4776 memcpy(body, conn->rbuf + header_len, (size_t)req->content_length);
4777 body[req->content_length] = '\0';
4778 cwist_sstring_adopt_len(req->body, body, (size_t)req->content_length);
4779 consumed += (size_t)req->content_length;
4780 }
4781 } else {
4782 /* Presence of TE implies parser-validated chunked framing. */
4783 if (te) {
4784 cwist_sstring *assembled = cwist_sstring_create();
4785 if (!assembled) {
4786 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4787 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_EOF;
4788 return CWIST_RECV_FATAL;
4789 }
4790 size_t chunk_bytes = 0;
4791 int scan =
4792 http_chunked_scan(conn->rbuf + header_len, body_received, &chunk_bytes, assembled);
4793 if (scan <= 0) {
4794 cwist_sstring_destroy(assembled);
4795 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
4796 if (scan == 0) {
4797 if (!http_async_stash_grow(conn, conn->len + 4096)) {
4798 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_EOF;
4799 return CWIST_RECV_FATAL;
4800 }
4801 return CWIST_RECV_NEED_MORE;
4802 }
4803 if (err_out) *err_out = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_MALFORMED;
4804 return CWIST_RECV_FATAL;
4805 }
4806 char *data = assembled->data;
4807 size_t dlen = assembled->size;
4808 assembled->data = NULL;
4809 assembled->size = 0;
4810 cwist_sstring_destroy(assembled);
4811 cwist_sstring_adopt_len(req->body, data, dlen);
4812 consumed += chunk_bytes;
4813 }
4814 }
4815
4816 /* Shift the leftover (pipelined bytes) to the stash head. */
4817 size_t leftover = conn->len - consumed;
4818 if (leftover > 0) memmove(conn->rbuf, conn->rbuf + consumed, leftover);
4819 conn->len = leftover;
4820 conn->rbuf[leftover] = '\0';
4821 conn->expect_continue_sent = false;
4822
4823 req->client_fd = conn->fd;
4824 *out = req;
4825 return CWIST_RECV_OK;
4826}
