4828/* --- End Non-blocking Request Assembly --- */
4829
4830typedef struct {
4831 const char *ext;
4832 const char *mime;
4833} cwist_mime_entry;
4834
4835static const cwist_mime_entry CWIST_MIME_TABLE[] = {{".html", "text/html; charset=utf-8"},
4836 {".htm", "text/html; charset=utf-8"},
4837 {".css", "text/css; charset=utf-8"},
4838 {".js", "application/javascript"},
4839 {".mjs", "application/javascript"},
4840 {".json", "application/json"},
4841 {".wasm", "application/wasm"},
4842 {".png", "image/png"},
4843 {".jpg", "image/jpeg"},
4844 {".jpeg", "image/jpeg"},
4845 {".gif", "image/gif"},
4846 {".svg", "image/svg+xml"},
4847 {".txt", "text/plain; charset=utf-8"},
4848 {".ico", "image/x-icon"}};
4849
4854static const char *cwist_guess_mime(const char *file_path) {
4855 if (!file_path) return "application/octet-stream";
4856 const char *dot = strrchr(file_path, '.');
4857 if (!dot) {
4858 return "application/octet-stream";
4859 }
4860 for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(CWIST_MIME_TABLE) / sizeof(CWIST_MIME_TABLE[0]); i++) {
4861 if (strcasecmp(dot, CWIST_MIME_TABLE[i].ext) == 0) {
4862 return CWIST_MIME_TABLE[i].mime;
4863 }
4864 }
4865 return "application/octet-stream";
4866}
4867
4876cwist_error_t cwist_http_response_send_file(cwist_http_response *res, const char *file_path,
4877 const char *content_type_hint, size_t *out_size) {
4878 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
4879 if (!res || !file_path) {
4880 err.error.err_i16 = -EINVAL;
4881 return err;
4882 }
4883
4884 cwist_http_response_release_file_stream(res);
4885 cwist_http_response_release_ptr_body(res);
4886
4887 int fd = open(file_path, O_RDONLY);
4888 if (fd < 0) {
4889 err.error.err_i16 = -errno;
4890 return err;
4891 }
4892
4893 struct stat st;
4894 if (fstat(fd, &st) < 0) {
4895 err.error.err_i16 = -errno;
4896 close(fd);
4897 return err;
4898 }
4899
4900 if (!S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) {
4901 close(fd);
4902 err.error.err_i16 = -EISDIR;
4903 return err;
4904 }
4905
4906 bool endpoint_file = cwist_endpoint_has(res->endpoint_opts, CWIST_ENDPOINT_FILE);
4907
4908 if (!endpoint_file && (size_t)st.st_size > CWIST_HTTP_MAX_BODY_SIZE) {
4909 close(fd);
4910 err.error.err_i16 = -EFBIG;
4911 return err;
4912 }
4913
4914 size_t file_size = (size_t)st.st_size;
4915 bool use_fast_stream = false;
4916
4917 if (file_size > 0 && endpoint_file) {
4918#if defined(__linux__) || defined(__APPLE__) || defined(__FreeBSD__)
4919 res->use_file_stream = true;
4920 res->file_stream_fd = fd;
4921 res->file_stream_len = file_size;
4922 res->file_stream_offset = 0;
4923 res->file_stream_auto_close = true;
4924 use_fast_stream = true;
4925#endif
4926 }
4927
4928 char *buffer = NULL;
4929
4930 if (!use_fast_stream && file_size > 0) {
4931 buffer = (char *)cwist_alloc(file_size + 1);
4932 if (!buffer) {
4933 close(fd);
4934 err.error.err_i16 = -ENOMEM;
4935 return err;
4936 }
4937 }
4938
4939 if (!use_fast_stream) {
4940 size_t total_read = 0;
4941 while (total_read < file_size) {
4942 ssize_t bytes = read(fd, buffer + total_read, file_size - total_read);
4943 if (bytes < 0) {
4944 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
4945 err.error.err_i16 = -errno;
4946 cwist_free(buffer);
4947 close(fd);
4948 return err;
4949 }
4950 if (bytes == 0) {
4951 err.error.err_i16 = -EIO;
4952 cwist_free(buffer);
4953 close(fd);
4954 return err;
4955 }
4956 total_read += (size_t)bytes;
4957 }
4958 close(fd);
4959
4960 if (file_size > 0) {
4961 /* Adopt the read buffer as the body: no second file-size copy. */
4962 buffer[file_size] = '\0';
4963 cwist_sstring_adopt_len(res->body, buffer, file_size);
4964 } else {
4965 cwist_sstring_borrow(res->body, "", 0);
4966 }
4967 } else {
4968 cwist_sstring_borrow(res->body, "", 0);
4969 }
4970
4971 const char *mime = content_type_hint ? content_type_hint : cwist_guess_mime(file_path);
4972 if (mime && !cwist_http_header_get(res->headers, "Content-Type")) {
4973 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Content-Type", mime);
4974 }
4975
4976 if (out_size) {
4977 *out_size = file_size;
4978 }
4979
4980 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_OK;
4981 err.error.err_i16 = 0;
4982 return err;
4983}

4989const char CWIST_BLOB_404[] =
4990 "HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\nContent-Length: 13\r\nConnection: keep-alive\r\n\r\n404 Not Found";

4994/* --- Socket Manipulation --- */
4995/* Everything from here on is the socket server runtime: WASI preview1 has
4996 * no sockets, so the whole section compiles out there. WASM hosts drive
4997 * requests through cwist_app_dispatch_memory() instead. */
4998#ifndef CWIST_WASI_NO_SOCKETS
4999
5008int cwist_make_socket_ipv4(struct sockaddr_in *sockv4, const char *address, uint16_t port,
5009 uint16_t backlog) {
5010 int server_fd = -1;
5011 int opt = 1;
5012
5013 if (!address || inet_pton(AF_INET, address, &sockv4->sin_addr) != 1) {
5014 return CWIST_HTTP_UNAVAILABLE_ADDRESS;
5015 }
5016
5017 if ((server_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0)) < 0) {
5018 cJSON *err_json = cJSON_CreateObject();
5019 cJSON_AddStringToObject(err_json, "err", "Failed to create IPv4 socket");
5020 char *cjson_error_log = cJSON_Print(err_json);
5021 perror(cjson_error_log);
5022 cwist_free(cjson_error_log);
5023 cJSON_Delete(err_json);
5024
5025 return CWIST_CREATE_SOCKET_FAILED;
5026 }
5027
5028 if (setsockopt(server_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt))) {
5029 cJSON *err_json = cJSON_CreateObject();
5030 cJSON_AddStringToObject(err_json, "err", "Failed to set up IPv4 socket options");
5031 char *cjson_error_log = cJSON_Print(err_json);
5032 perror(cjson_error_log);
5033 cwist_free(cjson_error_log);
5034 cJSON_Delete(err_json);
5035
5036 return CWIST_HTTP_SETSOCKOPT_FAILED;
5037 }
5038
5039#if defined(SO_REUSEPORT)
5040 setsockopt(server_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEPORT, &opt, sizeof(opt));
5041#endif
5042
5043#if defined(__APPLE__) || defined(__FreeBSD__)
5044#ifdef SO_NOSIGPIPE
5045 int no_sig_pipe = 1;
5046 setsockopt(server_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_NOSIGPIPE, &no_sig_pipe, sizeof(no_sig_pipe));
5047#endif
5048#endif
5049
5050 sockv4->sin_family = AF_INET;
5051 sockv4->sin_port = htons(port);
5052
5053 if (bind(server_fd, (struct sockaddr *)sockv4, sizeof(struct sockaddr_in)) < 0) {
5054 cJSON *err_json = cJSON_CreateObject();
5055 cJSON_AddStringToObject(err_json, "err", "Failed to bind IPv4 socket");
5056 char *cjson_error_log = cJSON_Print(err_json);
5057 perror(cjson_error_log);
5058 cwist_free(cjson_error_log);
5059 cJSON_Delete(err_json);
5060
5061 return CWIST_HTTP_BIND_FAILED;
5062 }
5063
5064 if (listen(server_fd, backlog) < 0) {
5065 cJSON *err_json = cJSON_CreateObject();
5066 char err_msg[128];
5067 char err_format[128] = "Failed to listen at %s:%d";
5068 snprintf(err_msg, 127, err_format, address, port);
5069
5070 cJSON_AddStringToObject(err_json, "err", err_msg);
5071 char *cjson_error_log = cJSON_Print(err_json);
5072 perror(cjson_error_log);
5073 cwist_free(cjson_error_log);
5074 cJSON_Delete(err_json);
5075
5076 return CWIST_HTTP_LISTEN_FAILED;
5077 }
5078
5079 return server_fd;
5080}

5087static bool cwist_accept_error_should_retry(int err) {
5088 switch (err) {
5089 case EINTR:
5090 case EAGAIN:
5091 case ECONNABORTED:
5092#ifdef ECONNRESET
5093 case ECONNRESET:
5094#endif
5095#ifdef EPROTO
5096 case EPROTO:
5097#endif
5098 return true;
5099 case EMFILE:
5100 case ENFILE:
5101 case ENOBUFS:
5102 case ENOMEM: return true;
5103 default: return false;
5104 }
5105}
5106
5111static void cwist_accept_error_backoff(int err) {
5112 switch (err) {
5113 case EMFILE:
5114 case ENFILE:
5115 case ENOBUFS:
5116 case ENOMEM: {
5117 fprintf(stderr, "[CWIST] accept() backoff triggered: %s\n", strerror(err));
5118 struct timespec ts;
5119 ts.tv_sec = 0;
5120 ts.tv_nsec = 50 * 1000 * 1000; // 50ms
5121 nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
5122 break;
5123 }
5124 default: break;
5125 }
5126}

5134#if !defined(__wasi__)
5135static void handle_client_forking(int client_fd, void (*handler_func)(int, void *), void *ctx) {
5136 pid_t pid = fork();
5137 if (pid == 0) {
5138 handler_func(client_fd, ctx);
5139 close(client_fd);
5140 _exit(0);
5141 } else if (pid > 0) {
5142 close(client_fd);
5143 }
5144}

5155cwist_error_t cwist_accept_socket(int server_fd, struct sockaddr *sockv4,
5156 void (*handler_func)(int client_fd, void *), void *ctx) {
5157 int client_fd = -1;
5158 struct sockaddr_in peer_addr;
5159 socklen_t addrlen = sizeof(peer_addr);
5160
5161 while (true) {
5162 if ((client_fd = accept(server_fd, (struct sockaddr *)&peer_addr, &addrlen)) < 0) {
5163 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
5164 // ... (error handling)
5165 if (errno == EBADF || errno == EINVAL || errno == ENOTSOCK) {
5166 fprintf(stderr, "Fatal socket error %d. Exiting accept loop.\n", errno);
5167 break;
5168 }
5169 continue;
5170 }
5171
5172 if (sockv4) {
5173 memcpy(sockv4, &peer_addr, sizeof(peer_addr));
5174 }
5175
5176 int nodelay = 1;
5177 setsockopt(client_fd, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_NODELAY, &nodelay, sizeof(nodelay));
5178
5179 handler_func(client_fd, ctx);
5180 }
5181
5182 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
5183 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
5184 return err;
5185}
5186
5195cwist_error_t cwist_http_server_loop(int server_fd, cwist_server_config *config,
5196 void (*handler)(int, void *), void *ctx) {
5197 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
5198 if (!config || server_fd < 0 || !handler) {
5199 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
5200 return err;
5201 }
5202
5203#if !defined(__wasi__)
5204 if (config->use_forking) {
5205 while (atomic_load(&g_cwist_running)) {
5206 int client_fd = accept(server_fd, NULL, NULL);
5207 if (client_fd < 0) {
5208 int accept_err = errno;
5209 if (accept_err == EBADF || accept_err == EINVAL) break;
5210 if (cwist_accept_error_should_retry(accept_err)) {
5211 cwist_accept_error_backoff(accept_err);
5212 continue;
5213 }
5214 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
5215 return err;
5216 }
5217 int nodelay = 1;
5218 setsockopt(client_fd, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_NODELAY, &nodelay, sizeof(nodelay));
5219 handle_client_forking(client_fd, handler, ctx);
5220 }
5221 }
5222#endif /* __wasi__ (no fork) */
5223
5224 if (config->use_threading) {
5225 /* This loop submits to the classic dynamic pool, so initialise that
5226 * pool whatever CWIST_C1M_MODE says (cwist_app_listen_ex() may have
5227 * overridden it). */
5228 if (cwist_http_pool_init_mode(false) != 0) {
5229 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
5230 return err;
5231 }
5232 while (atomic_load(&g_cwist_running)) {
5233 int client_fd = accept(server_fd, NULL, NULL);
5234 if (client_fd < 0) {
5235 int accept_err = errno;
5236 if (accept_err == EINTR) continue;
5237 if (accept_err == EBADF || accept_err == EINVAL || accept_err == ENOTSOCK) break;
5238 if (cwist_accept_error_should_retry(accept_err)) {
5239 cwist_accept_error_backoff(accept_err);
5240 continue;
5241 }
5242 continue;
5243 }
5244 int nodelay = 1;
5245 setsockopt(client_fd, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_NODELAY, &nodelay, sizeof(nodelay));
5246 cwist_http_pool_submit(client_fd, handler, ctx);
5247 }
5248 cwist_http_pool_destroy();
5249 err.error.err_i16 = 0;
5250 return err;
5251 }
5252
5253#ifdef __linux__
5254 if (config->use_epoll) {
5255 int flags = fcntl(server_fd, F_GETFL, 0);
5256 if (flags >= 0) fcntl(server_fd, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK);
5257
5258 int epoll_fd = epoll_create1(0);
5259 if (epoll_fd < 0) {
5260 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
5261 return err;
5262 }
5263 struct epoll_event event;
5264 event.events = EPOLLIN | EPOLLET;
5265 event.data.fd = server_fd;
5266 if (epoll_ctl(epoll_fd, EPOLL_CTL_ADD, server_fd, &event) < 0) {
5267 close(epoll_fd);
5268 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
5269 return err;
5270 }
5271
5272 while (atomic_load(&g_cwist_running)) {
5273 struct epoll_event events[1024];
5274 int count = epoll_wait(epoll_fd, events, 1024, -1);
5275 if (count < 0) {
5276 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
5277 if (errno == EBADF) break;
5278 break;
5279 }
5280 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
5281 if (events[i].data.fd == server_fd) {
5282 while (1) {
5283 int client_fd = accept(server_fd, NULL, NULL);
5284 if (client_fd >= 0) {
5285 int nodelay = 1;
5286 setsockopt(client_fd, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_NODELAY, &nodelay,
5287 sizeof(nodelay));
5288 handler(client_fd, ctx);
5289 } else {
5290 int accept_err = errno;
5291 if (accept_err == EAGAIN || accept_err == EWOULDBLOCK) break;
5292 if (accept_err == EBADF || accept_err == EINVAL) goto epoll_exit;
5293 if (accept_err == EINTR) continue;
5294 if (cwist_accept_error_should_retry(accept_err)) {
5295 cwist_accept_error_backoff(accept_err);
5296 continue;
5297 }
5298 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
5299 close(epoll_fd);
5300 return err;
5301 }
5302 }
5303 }
5304 }
5305 }
5306 epoll_exit:
5307 close(epoll_fd);
5308 }
5309#endif
5310
5311#if defined(__APPLE__) || defined(__FreeBSD__) || defined(__NetBSD__) || defined(__OpenBSD__)
5312 if (config->use_epoll) {
5313 int flags = fcntl(server_fd, F_GETFL, 0);
5314 if (flags >= 0) fcntl(server_fd, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK);
5315
5316 int kqueue_fd = kqueue();
5317 if (kqueue_fd < 0) {
5318 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
5319 return err;
5320 }
5321 struct kevent change;
5322 EV_SET(&change, server_fd, EVFILT_READ, EV_ADD | EV_CLEAR, 0, 0, NULL);
5323 if (kevent(kqueue_fd, &change, 1, NULL, 0, NULL) < 0) {
5324 close(kqueue_fd);
5325 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
5326 return err;
5327 }
5328
5329 while (atomic_load(&g_cwist_running)) {
5330 struct kevent events[16];
5331 int count = kevent(kqueue_fd, NULL, 0, events, 16, NULL);
5332 if (count < 0) {
5333 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
5334 if (errno == EBADF) break;
5335 break;
5336 }
5337 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
5338 if ((int)events[i].ident == server_fd) {
5339 while (1) {
5340 int client_fd = accept(server_fd, NULL, NULL);
5341 if (client_fd >= 0) {
5342 int nodelay = 1;
5343 setsockopt(client_fd, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_NODELAY, &nodelay,
5344 sizeof(nodelay));
5345 handler(client_fd, ctx);
5346 } else {
5347 int accept_err = errno;
5348 if (accept_err == EAGAIN || accept_err == EWOULDBLOCK) break;
5349 if (accept_err == EBADF || accept_err == EINVAL) goto kq_exit;
5350 if (accept_err == EINTR) continue;
5351 if (cwist_accept_error_should_retry(accept_err)) {
5352 cwist_accept_error_backoff(accept_err);
5353 continue;
5354 }
5355 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
5356 close(kqueue_fd);
5357 return err;
5358 }
5359 }
5360 }
5361 }
5362 }
5363 kq_exit:
5364 close(kqueue_fd);
5365 }
5366#endif
5367
5368 return cwist_accept_socket(server_fd, NULL, handler, ctx);
5369}
5370#endif /* __wasi__ (socket server runtime) */
